Typical engagements include: Cloud Strategy and Business Case Development, Cloud Suitability and Migration Assessments, Cloud Architecture Design and Implementation, On-Premise to Cloud Migrations, and Cloud Organizational Alignment.
  
  
Avez-vous une passion profonde pour l'utilisation de la technologie afin d'outiller les entreprises? Aimeriez-vous poursuivre une carrière qui aide les clients et les partenaires à atteindre leurs objectifs plus rapidement et à moindre coût grâce aux services infonuagiques?

Vous devrez mettre à profit vos compétences en relation client et votre sens technique pour comprendre les exigences des clients et les accompagner dans la mise en œuvre de leurs projets de transformation numérique.

  + OR equivalent experience.
* 2+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

Experience leading complex negotiations, strategic agreements and multi-stakeholder sales engagements.

Executive presence and credibility with C-suite stakeholders, combined with the discipline to drive detailed execution.

Experience within Fortinet’s ecosystem or a comparable cybersecurity vendor environment.

Fortinet is established as a strategic partner to the Group for both its internal transformation and customer-facing services.

Group-level and local teams operate with clear accountability, consistent opportunity attribution and a coordinated approach to the account.

* Help ensure that Splunk is designed into partners’ service catalogues across security, observability, infrastructure monitoring, and digital resilience.

* Align with Splunk Regional Sales Directors, Regional Sales Managers, AVPs, partner leadership, and other senior stakeholders.

* Prepare and deliver MSP business reviews and updates to regional, EMEA, and partner leadership teams.

Commercial Leadership and Negotiation
  
  

* Support commercial discussions and negotiations with MSP and MSSP partners.
* Work with the EMEA MSP team, legal, finance, pricing, operations, and deal-desk teams to develop scalable and commercially viable agreements.
* Help resolve complex pricing, licensing, contractual, and route-to-market considerations.
* Apply strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills to accelerate strategic opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Extensive experience working with MSPs, MSSPs, service providers, cloud providers, or technology partners.
* Deep understanding of the regional MSP and MSSP landscape, business models, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics.
* Demonstrated success in sales, business development, partner development, or go-to-market roles.
* Proven ability to translate regional strategies into executable partner and sales plans.

* Strong pipeline management, forecasting, business-planning, and executive communication skills.

* Fluency in English

Title: Director, Technology Operations
Description:
**Director, Technical Operations (Platform)**
**Job Type:**
Permanent Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
Hybrid - Toronto, Ontario
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Chief Technology Officer
  
  
**Salary**
: $160,000 – $190,000 CAD
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Director, Technology Operations owns the operational health of the platforms Goway sells and services travel on: our reservations platform, the infrastructure it runs on, the supplier, air and distribution integrations it depends on, and the automation and data pipelines built around it.
  
  
This is a practice-building role. You will define and own Goway's technical operations discipline: service levels, incident management, change control, observability and operational readiness, and you will make them the standard across our technology organisation. You will work alongside other Technology leaders. You will own the technology operations of our platform. You will have the CTO's mandate and backing to build the practice.
  
  
**What will be your key responsibilities?**
Reliability and service management
  
  

* Define, publish and report service levels and service-level objectives for revenue-critical services, starting with quoting, booking, payment and traveller servicing.
* Own incident management end to end: severity definitions, escalation, incident command, communication during an incident, and post-incident review with corrective actions.
* Own RCA and problem management.
* Own change and release management as a company standard, balancing delivery throughput against change failure rate.
* Build observability sufficient to detect degradation.
* Own disaster recovery and business continuity for platform services, tested and documented on a stated cadence.

Integration and supplier platform operations
  
  

* Monitoring of integration paths, error and failure-rate thresholds, and defined fallback behaviour when a partner degrades.
* Maintain a dependency map of the external platforms our revenue-generating flows rely on, with assessed operational risk and mitigation for each.
* Own operational readiness for new integrations and new product lines entering the platform.
* Own the operational reliability of automation and data pipelines in production.

Platform and cloud operations
  
  

* Day-to-day operation of the AWS and managed hosting infrastructure serving our platform estate: environments, provisioning, patching and lifecycle management.
* Own hosting cost governance: visibility by service, a unit-cost measure, and an annual optimisation target.
* Lead capacity planning against forecast booking and travel volumes.
* Reduce manual, repeatable operational work through automation.
* Address seasonal capacity planning, change freezes and enhanced coverage aligned to our booking and departure peaks and to new product launches.

Vendors, partners and compliance
  
  

* Platform, hosting and integration partner relationships: SLA definition, enforcement and structured performance review.
* Reduce single points of dependency, whether on a vendor or an individual.
* Partner with security on vulnerability management, patch compliance, access control and audit readiness.

Practice leadership and stakeholder engagement
  
  

* Build and maintain a multi-year technical operations roadmap aligned to Goway's growth plans.
* Report operational performance, risk and investment needs to the CTO and executive team in business terms.

**What are we looking for?**
**Required**

* 8 or more years in platform operations, technical operations, infrastructure or site reliability engineering, including 5 or more years in a lead or leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated accountability for the availability and performance of a revenue-critical transactional platform.
* Evidence of having built operational practice where little existed: SLOs, incident management, change control and observability introduced from the ground up, with measurable improvement to show for it.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, including cost management and multi-environment operation.
* Substantial experience operating and governing third-party platforms and integrations, including holding vendors to service levels.
* Ability to set standards and drive adoption across teams.
* Ability to communicate operational risk and performance.

**Preferred**

* Experience stabilising and operationalising new systems.
* Infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration experience.
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer (Professional), or AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer (Associate). Solutions Architect certifications are welcome, but less relevant to this role than the operations-focused ones.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or equivalent practical experience.

**What can you expect from Goway?**

* Imagine working for a company where your career feels like an adventure. At Goway, you’ll join a global community that supports one another:
* We offer a competitive salary accompanied by performance incentives, and we place real importance on time away from work, such as paid personal days for when life calls for them and your birthday off each year.
* Our commitment to professional growth means you’ll have access to continuous learning and industry-leading training that keeps you at the forefront of travel innovation.
* You’ll enjoy generous paid time off, including [three] weeks of vacation, [six] personal days, and a dedicated day off to celebrate your birthday.
* Travel is in our DNA, so you’ll enjoy exclusive perks and discounts on worldwide getaways.
* Since we operate across Toronto, Vancouver, Los Angeles, Manila, Sydney, and beyond, you’ll collaborate across cultures and shape a career path that reflects your ambitions.
* Goway is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate differences and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace for everyone. We appreciate every applicant’s interest. Please be advised that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

**How To Apply**
If this role feels like your next step, click "Apply Now" to create your profile, upload your CV, and share a few details about yourself. Our talent team reviews every application, and if your experience aligns with our needs, we will reach out to set up the next step.
  
  
**AI Screening Disclosure**
To help us fairly and efficiently review applications, we use an automated screening process to assess responses to pre-determined questions. This initial step ensures all candidates are evaluated consistently. Qualified applicants will be reviewed by our recruitment team for further consideration.
  
  
**Additional Notes**
Goway Travel Ltd will retain applications, notifications, and records related to this posting for three years, reflecting our commitment to fair and equitable hiring practices.
  
  
**Recruitment Scams & Fraud Warning**
Please be aware of any suspicious emails or WhatsApp activity from individuals pretending to be recruiters or senior personnel at Goway Travel. We will never ask you to install an app during the recruitment process. If you receive a message of this nature, please ignore it and report it to Goway.
  
  
**About Goway**
Founded in Toronto in 1970 by Australian economist Bruce Hodge, Goway has evolved from a one-person dream into a family-owned global leader in tailor-made travel. With our headquarters in Toronto and hubs in Vancouver, Los Angeles, Sydney, and Manila, our team of over 800 talented employees designs travel experiences in more than 115 countries across all seven continents. We’re united by a passion for travel and are committed to doing the right thing: supporting diversity, equity, inclusion, and sustainable tourism that enriches local communities. Whether working remotely or side by side in one of our offices, we operate as one forward-thinking team, transforming wanderlust into life-changing adventures for our fellow Globetrotters. Discover more at goway.com.

Title: Manager - AI Security Platform Management
Description:
**Job Description**
The role lead the end-to-end development of our AI-powered cybersecurity platform, owning its product vision, roadmap, and delivery. Acting as Product Owner and technical lead, you will translate the needs of our security teams (threat detection, investigation, response, and risk management) into AI capabilities built on classical ML and modern LLM/agentic architectures. You will guide a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and security specialists to ship a platform that is effective, reliable, secure by design, and trusted by its users across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Product Vision & Strategy
* Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI-driven cybersecurity platform aligned with business and security objectives.
* Identify and prioritize high-value security use cases (e.g., alert triage, threat hunting, incident investigation, vulnerability prioritization, threat intelligence summarization, automated response).
* Track the AI security tooling market and inform build vs. buy vs. partner decisions.
* Product Ownership & Delivery
* Own and prioritize the product backlog; write clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria with input from SOC, threat intelligence, and risk teams.
* Lead agile ceremonies (planning, refinement, reviews) and drive iterative delivery from MVP to production at scale.
* Define and track product KPIs and OKRs (e.g., analyst time saved, mean time to detect/respond, detection precision, adoption).
* Platform Architecture & Engineering Leadership
* Lead the design and development of the platform, including:

 Data ingestion and pipelines for security telemetry (SIEM, EDR, network, cloud, and identity logs, threat intelligence feeds).
  
  
 LLM, RAG, and agentic workflows with tool calling and integrations with security tools
  
  
 Model selection, fine-tuning, and serving across self-hosted options (open-weight models).
  
  
 Model gateways, prompt management, and guardrail policies.
  
  
 MCP servers and APIs that expose platform capabilities to other teams and systems.
  
  
 Analyst-facing experiences: copilots, dashboards, and human-in-the-loop review flows.
  
  

* AI Quality, Evaluation & Reliability
* Establish evaluation pipelines and benchmarks to measure the accuracy, robustness, bias, and hallucination rate of AI outputs on real security scenarios.
* Define SLOs/SLAs and observability for the platform, including fallback strategies and human escalation paths.
* Secure-by-Design Development
* Ensure the platform itself is secure by design: threat modeling (e.g., MAESTRO, OWASP GenAI / LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS), secure CI/CD, dependency and model supply-chain checks, and policy-as-code.
* Protect the sensitive security data handled by the platform through data classification, masking, DLP, and least-privilege access.
* Validation & Red Teaming
* Partner with red teams to test the platform against prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and agent misuse before and after each release.
* Validate platform detections and recommendations against realistic attack simulations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
* Turn findings from testing and production incidents into backlog items and continuous product improvements.
* Governance, Compliance & Responsible AI
* Ensure the platform complies with applicable AI regulations and standards (e.g., EU AI Act, regional laws, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) and internal AI use policies.
* Define responsible AI practices for the product: transparency and explainability of recommendations, data usage, model lifecycle, and third-party AI vendor risk.
* Stakeholder & Team Leadership
* Act as the primary point of contact between security operations, engineering, business, and leadership; communicate roadmap, progress, and trade-offs.
* Lead and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and security specialists; manage vendors and partners as needed.
* Drive adoption through demos, training, and feedback loops with end users (SOC analysts, threat hunters, risk teams).

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 8–12+ years in Cybersecurity, with 3–5+ years focused on AI/ML or data platforms (can be overlapping).
* Hands-on experience with:

oCloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and their AI services.
  
  
oAt least one Agentic/GenAI stack (e.g., Transformers, LangChain/LlamaIndex, vector DBs, model gateways, MLOps platforms).
  
  

* Proven track record designing or reviewing secure architectures for:

oML pipelines, LLM/RAG systems, or agentic/automation platforms.
  
  

* Strong understanding of:

oCryptography, identity & access management, network & app security.
  
  
oData protection & privacy (PII, PHI, DPIA concepts).
  
  

* Experience working with or mapping to frameworks/standards such as:

oNIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001, SOC 2, OWASP Top 10 & OWASP GenAI/LLM Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK/ATLAS, CSA guidance.
  
  

* Excellent communication skills: able to translate complex AI risks into clear business and technical requirements.

Core Technical & Domain Skills
  
  

* AI/ML & GenAI fundamentals:

oModel types (LLMs, encoders, diffusion, classical ML), training/inference flows.
  
  
oData pipelines, feature stores, embeddings, vector databases.
  
  

* AI Penetration testing:

oPrompt injection, model tampering, data poisoning, output manipulation, exfiltration, shadow AI, insecure plugins/integrations.
  
  

* Platform & Infra:
* Kubernetes, containers, API gateways, secrets management, zero trust.

Title: Delivery Program Director
Description:
Position Overview:

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. This includes defining support processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinating with shared support and maintenance functions to ensure seamless collaboration and the delivery of reliable 24/7 customer support within SLA targets.

Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.
* Build a joint customer success model across SBS product lines and regions.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

* Act as the single point of accountability for the customer experience across Support, Customer Success and delivery teams.
* Ensure customer experience responsiveness, predictability and transparency on incidents, releases and roadmap commitments.
* Own escalation management, personally leading critical escalations through to resolution and clear communication with the client.
* Work with Professional Services to ensure a smooth handover from project to run, so every go live lands well.

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.
* Own the voice of the customer: CSAT and NPS programs, app store ratings and structured feedback loops into Product.
* Contribute to the SBS Customer Satisfaction Program and embed the Golden Disciplines across customer-facing teams.
* Protect renewals by working with Account Managers well ahead of renewal dates, so there are no surprises.

**Maximize product adoption and realized value**

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

Qualifications:

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.
* Strong track record in banking or financial services software, ideally in digital banking, open banking, payments or lending.
* Experience managing both SaaS and customer managed (on premise) clients, including SLA governance and major incident management.
* Credible with bank executives and comfortable leading difficult conversations when things go wrong.
* Experience across the Middle East and Africa, ideally with exposure to the US and Europe. Knowledge of the GCC banking market is a strong plus.
* Comfortable working in a matrix organization and influencing teams that do not report directly to them.
* Hands-on leader who can operate at executive level while confidently diving into the operational and technical details as required.
* Commercially astute, technically capable, and credible in banking conversations with both business and technology stakeholders.

Skills

Education

Purolator relies on a broad portfolio of production applications to support employees, customers, terminals, transportation, and business operations. We are seeking a technology manager to lead the team accountable for application support, reliability, lifecycle management, and enhancements across these services.
  
  
This role will strengthen the operating model for production support by ensuring that projects, support queues, knowledge, monitoring, incidents, vulnerabilities, maintenance, and improvement work are managed with discipline. The successful candidate will combine strong leadership with technical judgement to deliver on new functionality and projects, improve service health, reduce repeat issues, and make support work visible and sustainable.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop application support employees, contractors, and vendor resources across onshore and offshore locations.
* Own service health and support outcomes for assigned production applications, including availability, performance, security, supportability, and lifecycle risk.

* Ensure knowledge base articles, runbooks, support procedures, dependency maps, recovery steps, and escalation contacts are accurate, current, usable, and reviewed on a defined cadence.
* Drive strong incident and problem management practices, including major incident leadership, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, trend analysis, and prevention of repeat failures.

* Use ServiceNow, Jira, dashboards, and other systems of record to provide accurate visibility into work, aging, service performance, backlog health, and risk.

* Set team goals, complete performance reviews, provide regular feedback, and support career development and succession planning.

**Experience**

Title: Senior Delivery Manager
Description:
Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.  
We've earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

**Position Overview**

As a Senior Delivery Manager, you are the senior delivery authority on a cross-functional engagement: owning execution from kickoff through release, leading distributed onshore-and-offshore teams, and serving as the primary delivery partner to the client. You bring the judgment to navigate ambiguity, the discipline to keep complex programs on track, and the instinct to make every engagement a foundation for the next one.

  

**Why This Role Matters**

Senior Delivery Managers are where Robots and Pencils' promise of "production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days" actually has to hold. On the engagements you run, you set the pace of delivery, the discipline behind it, and the trust that decides whether the client comes back for more. The work moves only as fast as someone is willing to own the plan, surface trade-offs early, and keep distributed teams pulling in the same direction.

**What** **You'll** **Do**

**Craft & Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-phase engagements, ensuring alignment across scope, budget, timeline, and quality to meet delivery commitments and achieve successful outcomes

* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution across one or more cross-functional teams

* Manage phased releases, production readiness, and transitions into operations and maintenance models

* Identify and proactively manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and escalations before they become blockers

* Define, track, and report delivery KPIs, using data to guide decisions, manage delivery health, and inform tradeoffs across scope, timeline, and budget

* Support QA and UAT efforts, ensuring quality is validated and outcomes meet agreed acceptance criteria

* Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and stakeholder communications

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Serve as the primary delivery contact for clients, building trusted relationships through transparency, consistency, and clear communication while identifying opportunities to expand value within the engagement

* Lead stakeholder working sessions, roadmap alignment discussions, and delivery forums with confidence

* Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to executive and non-technical audiences

* Partner with Client Partners to spot expansion opportunities inside the engagement (scope, follow-on work, new use cases) and help shape the case for what's next

* Translate delivery progress into business impact for client stakeholders (ROI, milestones, decisions) so executives see ongoing value, not just status

**Leadership & Influence**

* Lead distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence

* Coach junior delivery managers with concrete feedback and stretch opportunities, contributing to their development plans

* Foster a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and high performance across the engagement

* Contribute to improving delivery practices, tools, and frameworks across engagements

* Assess team strengths and gaps on your engagements, and partner with Client Partners to flag staffing needs and high-potential talent for the firm

* Conduct executive interviews for engineers, designers, and other roles joining your engagements, and serve as an essential voice in go/no-go hiring decisions across the firm

  

**What** **You'll** **Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in software delivery, technical project management, or engineering leadership

* Strong understanding of agile delivery practices across complex, multi-team engagements (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, Kanban)

* Experience managing distributed teams across onshore and offshore locations

* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-platform digital systems in agile environments

* Strong client-facing communication and relationship management skills

* Experience with delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines)

* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and AI-enabled platforms

* Demonstrable usage of AI tools to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and documentation (e.g., Claude)

* PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, or equivalent certification preferred

* Experience in regulated environments (e.g., utilities, government, finance) is a plus

* Instinct for spotting where an engagement can grow, and the credibility with clients to bring those conversations forward with Client Partners

  

**Helpful Extras and Unique Skills**

* Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing

* Experience delivering agentic, AI co-worker, or applied-AI initiatives in enterprise

* Prior career experience in client-facing roles (engagement management, consulting, account leadership) that informs growth conversations

**You'll** **Do Well Here if You Are**

* **A doer.** You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.

* **A fast learner who knows you don't know everything.** The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.

* **Direct in a way that makes the work better.** You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.

* **Obsessed with craft.** You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.

* **Built for ownership.** You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.

* **All in.** You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.

* **Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight.** Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.

* **Calm when it gets hot.** When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You'd rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.

* **Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do.** Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

**Purpose**
-----------

The ServiceNow Platform Lead provides hands-on technical leadership for the administration, configuration, development, integration, automation, testing, and continuous improvement of the ServiceNow platform.

  

The ServiceNow Platform Lead serves as the primary technical lead for the platform, working under the direction of the Senior Manager, Service Management, Automation & Observability, who retains accountability for ServiceNow platform ownership, strategy, governance, roadmap, priorities, and investment decisions.
  
The role works closely with ITSM process owners, business stakeholders, technical teams, managed service providers, and implementation partners to translate business and operational requirements into scalable and supportable ServiceNow solutions.

#LI-Hybrid

Title: Manager, Digital Assets Transformation
Description:
Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  
  
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 04/19/2027.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As a Manager, Digital Assets Transformation on the AI & Engineering, Industry Solutions team, you will be responsible for:  
  
Lead engagements and major workstreams for banks, broker-dealers, asset managers, and market infrastructure clients.  

* Develop digital asset strategies, business cases, and target-state operating models for stablecoins, tokenized deposits, tokenized securities and funds, real-world assets, institutional custody and trading, and blockchain-based payments and settlement.
* Guide functional design, platform design, and integration of digital asset capabilities with core banking and capital markets platforms.
* Structure problems, test hypotheses, develop recommendations, review deliverables, and present findings to senior client executives.
* Build client relationships, contribute to proposals and thought leadership, identify follow-on opportunities, and coach junior team members.

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Our AI and Engineering, Industry Solutions offering provides verticalized solutions that transform how clients sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and execute mission-critical operations. We deliver integrated business expertise with scalable, repeatable technology solutions specifically engineered for each sector.  
  
Deloitte's Financial Services Industry consulting practice is the largest in the world, serving over 90% of Fortune 500 banking, insurance, securities, investment management, and real estate companies.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:
  

* Bachelor's degree
* 8+ years of experience in strategy, operations, product, or business and technology transformation within a management consulting firm or financial institution, including a bank, broker-dealer, asset manager, or payments company
* 6+ years of experience in digital assets, blockchain, or tokenization, including stablecoins, tokenized deposits or securities, crypto custody and trading, or blockchain-based payments and settlement, within a consulting firm, financial institution, or digital asset company
* 6+ years of experience delivering banking or capital markets consulting engagements or technology transformation initiatives for financial institutions, including functional design, target-state definition, and end-to-end execution across the project lifecycle; or 6+ years of industry experience in payments, treasury, securities services, or market infrastructure
* 4+ years of experience leading teams or major workstreams, reviewing deliverables, coordinating work across business and engineering teams, managing client relationships, presenting recommendations to senior client executives, contributing to proposal responses and thought leadership, and coaching junior team members
* Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  
Preferred:
  

* Experience defining problem statements, developing approaches when project scope or requirements are not fully defined, and influencing stakeholders without direct reporting relationships in matrixed organizations
* Experience conducting quantitative and qualitative research, market sizing, and business case development for digital asset products
* Experience creating executive presentations, target operating models, and roadmaps for business and technical audiences
* Experience applying regulatory, risk, and compliance requirements to digital asset initiatives, including federal stablecoin legislation; Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) oversight; bank regulatory guidance on crypto activities; Bank Secrecy Act/Anti-Money Laundering (BSA/AML) and Travel Rule requirements; sanctions screening; and Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) frameworks
* Experience in one or more digital asset domains, including stablecoins and tokenized deposits, tokenized securities and funds, institutional custody, digital asset trading and prime services, or blockchain-based cross-border payments; and experience with public and permissioned blockchain networks, smart contracts, wallet and key management, custody models, interoperability, digital asset and market infrastructure platforms (e.g., Fireblocks, Anchorage, BitGo, Paxos, Circle, Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Broadridge DLR, Kinexys), and their integration with core banking, treasury, or capital markets systems. Experience with Ethereum or Canton is preferred.
* Advanced degree (e.g., Master of Business Administration (MBA), Master of Science in Engineering (M.S. Engineering), or equivalent) or relevant professional certification (e.g., Project Management Professional (PMP), Six Sigma, Lean, Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), or a blockchain or digital asset credential)

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $155,600 to $306,800.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Title: Product Manager I
Description:
Take a step forward and let Edenred surprise you.

Every day, we deliver innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people, connecting employees, companies, and merchants all around the world.

We know there are hundred ways for you to grow. With us, you will expand your skills in a multicultural, challenging, and dynamic environment.

**Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.**

Edenred is all about meritocracy. You come as you are, and you contribute. Indeed, the Edenred Group recognizes, recruits and develops all talents and singularities.

We are committed to preventing all forms of discrimination and to providing all our candidates with equal opportunities regardless of their gender and gender expression, disability, origin, religious belief and sexual orientation or any other criteria.

**About Edenred**

Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

  

**The UAE CONTEXT**

Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.

We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).

  

**THE ROLE**

Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.

You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.

Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.

The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.

* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.

* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.

* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.

* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.

* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.

* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.

* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.

* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.

Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.  

  

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.

* Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.

* Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.

* Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.

* Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.

* Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.

* Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:

* Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.

* Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.

* Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.

* Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.

* Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.

  

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

Reporting to: Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, depending on the area you join.

Working with: Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance, Financial Crime, Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, and product managers across the business.

  

**WHY THIS ROLE**

You will not be the eleventh PM on a mature product in a crowded market. You will own high-visibility initiatives end-to-end, from problem definition to measurable business outcome, on a platform that has a direct, visible effect on the financial lives of millions of people.

If that sounds like your kind of problem, apply.

  

*Edenred UAE is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, gender, age, religion or background.*

  
  

**Apply now and Vibe with Us!**

Title: Senior Manager - QA & Site Co-ordination - AA9
Description:
Lead the independent quality assurance and site co-ordination function for City Ops ICT assets throughout the project lifecycle. Establish and operate consistent quality controls, stage-gate checkpoints, inspection and testing arrangements, and evidence-based validation of operational requirements before handover and service transition. Maintain objective oversight of gaps, defects and remediation, while keeping delivery accountability with the relevant project, contractor, vendor or asset owner. Set the strategic QA direction, lead the assurance team and provide senior management with independent recommendations on quality, readiness and residual risk.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Independent, evidence-based judgement and challenge of incomplete readiness evidence
* Senior leadership of QA/QC governance, quality strategy, risk prioritisation and structured issue escalation
* Clear stakeholder communication, cross-vendor co-ordination and executive, audit-ready reporting
* Ability to direct field verification teams and manage site access, safety and inspection logistics
* Portfolio-level prioritisation, resource planning, supplier performance oversight and continuous improvement
* QA Governance & Independence
* Own and maintain the City Ops ICT QA/QC and gap-assessment framework, including standards, workflows, evidence requirements, severity classification, validation, prioritisation, closure and reporting.
* Define QA checkpoints, sign-off criteria, Site Inspection Plans, asset-specific checklists, test scripts, hold / witness points and acceptance evidence standards.
* Provide independent assessment of operational readiness and quality, separate from project delivery accountability; challenge incomplete or disputed evidence and escalate material acceptance risks.
* Lead the QA team, including field / testing and domain verification resources, and apply consistent methods across sites and packages.
* Set portfolio QA priorities, allocate assurance resources and provide senior leadership with independent recommendations on systemic quality risks and readiness.

* Site Co-ordination, Inspection & Testing
* Plan and co-ordinate site access, inspections, permits, inductions, vendor attendance, equipment and documentation for site verification activities.
* Direct and quality-assure document reviews, physical inspections, interviews and functional testing performed by Field and Test Engineers.
* Co-ordinate physical and functional verification of ICT infrastructure and systems, including cabling / fibre, switches, equipment rooms, CCTV / VMS, access control, UPS and associated power arrangements.
* Ensure inspection records contain checklists, photos, test results, calibration and safety evidence, with a clear pass, gap or not-applicable outcome.
* Operational Readiness & Handover Assurance
* Translate approved service, support, monitoring, resilience, cybersecurity, lifecycle and non-functional requirements into measurable acceptance criteria.
* Validate readiness evidence, test and commissioning results, as-built and configuration records, asset information, licences, warranties, training, O&M documentation and support arrangements.
* Provide an evidence-based recommendation on handover readiness, documenting exceptions, residual risks, conditional acceptance and corrective actions; do not replace the authorised acceptance decision-maker.
* Confirm outstanding defects, vendor obligations and support information are transferred into the appropriate QTech ITSM / ServiceNow and operational governance processes.
* Issue Management, Reporting & Escalation
* Own and maintain the Master Gap Register, Defect / Snag Register and Remediation Tracker as controlled, traceable records.
* Validate findings for evidence sufficiency, severity, ownership and corrective action; track target dates and verify objective closure evidence.
* Escalate critical / high findings, disputed classifications, safety concerns and unresolved readiness risks through agreed governance channels.
* Prepare dashboards, executive summaries and decision-ready reporting on quality status, ageing, dependencies, closure trends and handover risks; lead root-cause reviews and continuous improvement.
* Stakeholder & Team Co-ordination
* Co-ordinate inspections, validation workshops and readiness reviews with City Ops ICT, QTech, MDU / EBU, Districts, Cybersecurity, vendors, contractors and service integrators.
* Provide leadership, work direction and coaching to field / test engineers and support consistent technical and audit-ready quality records.
* Hold delivery partners accountable for evidence quality and remediation commitments while preserving independent assurance boundaries.
* Seven Stage-Gate Quality Checkpoints
* CP1 - Understand Project Scope: Confirm asset / system scope, site constraints, applicable standards, stakeholders and QA approach.
* CP2 - Define City ICT Operations Requirements: Translate operational, service and non-functional requirements into measurable acceptance criteria.
* CP3 - Review Procurement Packages: Review RFPs, BoQs and specifications for inspection, testing, handover, support and evidence provisions.
* CP4 - Review Material Submissions: Review technical / material submissions, methods and test plans; flag deviations and lifecycle impacts.
* CP5 - Verify Delivered Requirements: Witness inspections and tests, validate as-built / configuration evidence and track defects to closure.
* CP6 - Support Handover Acceptance: Review handover packs and readiness evidence; recommend acceptance, exceptions and corrective actions.
* CP7 - Service Management Transition: Confirm quality records, support procedures and open obligations are transferred into operational governance.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Minimum Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics or a related discipline.

**Professional Certifications**

Preferred: PMP / PRINCE2, ITIL Foundation and ISO 9001 auditor or equivalent QA qualification; advantageous: Lean Six Sigma and relevant technical / testing certifications.

**Skills**

* ICT QA/QC governance, inspection / test planning, stage-gate assurance and evidence-based acceptance.
* Practical understanding of ICT infrastructure, smart-city and physical-security systems, commissioning, operational readiness and service transition.
* Defect and gap classification, root-cause analysis, remediation tracking, registers, dashboards and audit-ready reporting.
* Site safety, permit-to-work, field inspection co-ordination, cross-vendor dependencies and stakeholder management.
* Independent judgement, clear escalation, strong written reporting and the ability to challenge incomplete evidence constructively.
* Experience leading gap / defect registers, site inspection programmes, acceptance criteria and management reporting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics or related discipline.

Title: Head of Internal Audit
Description:
**Take Your Career to New Heights with Flair Airlines**

At Flair Airlines, we’re making air travel more affordable and accessible for everyone, and our people are at the heart of making that happen. As we continue to expand our network, increase flight frequencies, and introduce more services, we’re looking for passionate team members to help us deliver on that mission. We know who we are, and we’re confident in our approach.

**Your Team:**

Join Flair’s Legal team, where effective governance, risk management, and internal controls support organizational accountability and informed decision-making. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer and General Counsel and functionally to the Audit Committee, the Head of Internal Audit is responsible for leading and directing the Internal Audit function, providing independent, objective assurance and practical advice across corporate, commercial, and operational activities.

The Head of Internal Audit supports effective Board oversight by evaluating governance practices, risk management processes, and internal controls, identifying areas for improvement, and providing recommendations to management. Working alongside aviation safety, security, and compliance assurance functions, the role maintains the distinct responsibilities of each function while supporting a coordinated approach to assurance across the organization.

The role safeguards the independence and objectivity of Internal Audit, including when coordinating management programs, while ensuring ownership of risks and controls remains with management.

This is an on-site position based at our Calgary (YYC), Toronto (YYZ), and Edmonton (YEG) offices.

**A Day in the Life:**

* Support the Board and the Audit Committee in the discharge of their governance responsibilities.
* Articulate and deliver the purpose of internal auditing, strengthening the organization’s ability to create, protect, and sustain value by providing the Board and management with independent, risk-based, and objective assurance, advice, insight, and foresight in service of the organization’s and public’s interests.
* Align Internal Audit function activities with the organization’s strategy, objectives, and risks, including major transformation programs, mergers and acquisitions, technology modernization initiatives, and emerging business models, and demonstrate the value the Internal Audit function delivers to the Board and senior management.
* Establish, maintain, and periodically review the Internal Audit mandate, strategy, and charter with the Audit Committee, defining the Internal Audit function’s mandate, authority, role and responsibilities. Engage the Board and senior management on the essential conditions of support, including independence, resources, and oversight, which enable an effective Internal Audit function.
* Develop and execute an annual risk-based audit plan for Audit Committee approval, updating priorities as risks change. Evaluate financial, operational, technology and regulatory controls across airline activities, including flight and ground operations governance, maintenance and engineering, fleet acquisition and leasing, airport and outsourced service providers, procurement and contract compliance, revenue accounting, distribution, cybersecurity, customer data protection and operational resilience, where relevant. Evaluate opportunities for appropriate reliance on the work of other assurance providers while maintaining accountability for Internal Audit conclusions. Assess safety and security governance in coordination with specialist assurance functions.
* Oversee planning and execution of assurance and advisory engagements that develop sound findings, conclusions, and actionable recommendations and/or management action plans.
* Communicate engagement results to senior management and the Audit Committee, and other stakeholders, highlighting significant findings, business implications, agreed actions and assurance coverage. Monitor and report on the implementation of agreed-upon management action plans using a risk-based approach, validate closure of significant findings and promptly escalate material concerns, overdue actions or unacceptable risk exposure.
* Maintain Internal Audit methodologies and lead delivery in accordance with the Institute of Internal Auditors' (IIA) Global Internal Audit Standards and applicable Topical Requirements. Maintain a quality assurance and improvement (QAIP) program, including ongoing monitoring, periodic internal assessments and external quality assessments at least every five years.
* Report periodically to the Board on internal audit engagement results, themes, systemic risks, risk trends, management action plan status, including timelines and overdue items, and matters that may exceed risk appetite. Title: Sr Service Manager – Digital Workplace & Field Services
Description:
**Details:**
**Job Title: Sr Service Manager - Digital Workplace & Field Services**
****Key Attributes To Feature In The Job Posting:****

* Technical Service Ownership of Modern Endpoint Services: Serve as the on-site single point of contact and technical service owner for endpoint management (SCCM/MECM, Intune, JAMF), M365 collaboration, Confluence, Citrix virtual workplace, and vulnerability management, accountable for SLAs and service health.
* Governance & Operational Readiness Leadership: Define and run ITIL-based governance (reporting, metrics, risk, controls, SOPs) across endpoint and Field Services, driving patch and vulnerability compliance, continuous improvement, automation, and AI-enabled service enhancements.

****Who We Are****
Founded in 1987, Stefanini helps midsize, large and global enterprises increase the efficiency of their IT operations while leveraging technology to empower their businesses. Our offerings include IT Infrastructure Outsourcing, End-User Computing, Application Managed Services, and Mainframe Modernization, with solutions spanning automation, cloud, IoT, UX, and AI alongside service desk, field service, and BPO. We have over 30,000 employees across 77 offices in 41 countries.
  
  
****Job Description****
This on-site Technical Service Manager role leads Modern Endpoint and Digital Workplace services for a key strategic client, combined with oversight of the Field Services teams and vendors that support the client's operations across multiple regions. You will be the single point of contact and technical service owner for endpoint management (SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune, JAMF), M365 collaboration, Confluence, Citrix virtual workplace, and vulnerability management, ensuring operational readiness, security compliance, and an excellent end-user experience. In this blended role, you will connect technical service ownership with hands-on Field Services delivery, so that endpoint, collaboration, and security outcomes are carried out on the ground through on-site deskside support, hardware lifecycle, and site services. Working closely with client stakeholders, the Business Unit Leader, and the Client Success Director, you will drive program strategy, ensure operational readiness, own governance and service quality, and lead continuous improvement and innovation. This position requires strong attention to detail, technical breadth across the digital workplace, and excellent interpersonal skills.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Modern Endpoint & Digital Workplace Services**

* Serve as technical service owner for Modern Endpoint services across Windows, macOS, and mobile devices
* Oversee endpoint management platforms: SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune (including Autopilot and co-management), and JAMF for Apple devices
* Govern OS deployment, application packaging and distribution, patching, configuration baselines, and device compliance
* Oversee M365 collaboration services (Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive) and Confluence/Atlassian collaboration platforms
* Manage Citrix Virtual Workplace (Virtual Apps and Desktops/VDI) service health, capacity, and user experience
* Own vulnerability management for the endpoint estate: drive remediation, patch SLAs, and compliance reporting with Security teams (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, CrowdStrike, Defender)
* Align the client environment with the Microsoft Evergreen roadmap and plan platform upgrades and migrations (e.g., SCCM to Intune)
* Track endpoint KPIs (compliance, patch currency, deployment success, device health) and report to client leadership

**Field Services Delivery & On-Site Support**

* Lead on-site and regional Field Services teams delivering deskside support, break/fix, and IMAC (install, move, add, change) activities
* Oversee dispatch, ticket routing, and work-order management to meet response and resolution SLAs across sites
* Manage Tech Bar / walk-up support, smart lockers, loaner pools, and VIP / executive support services
* Coordinate hardware lifecycle: device provisioning, imaging, deployment, refresh, and secure disposal (including data sanitization)
* Govern IT asset management in the field: inventory accuracy, stockroom controls, and asset lifecycle tracking in the CMDB
* Lead site readiness for office openings, moves, closures, and large-scale refresh or migration projects
* Monitor field performance metrics (first-time fix rate, SLA attainment, backlog, CSAT) and drive corrective actions

**Integrating Field Services with Technical Service Management**

* Translate endpoint and security priorities into field execution plans (e.g., on-site remediation of non-compliant or unpatched devices)
* Use Intune, Autopilot, SCCM/MECM, and JAMF to enable zero-touch provisioning and reduce on-site effort and costs
* Coordinate Field Services with Service Desk, Endpoint Engineering, Security, and Citrix/VDI teams for seamless incident and change execution
* Use device health and monitoring data to plan proactive field visits and hardware replacement before failures occur
* Ensure field technicians are trained and certified on current endpoint platforms, tools, and SOPs
* Make sure field-driven changes follow change management and security controls
* Report combined endpoint and field service performance to client leadership in a single governance view

**Client Relationship & Service Delivery**

* Act as on-site Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the client and senior-level stakeholders
* Own day-to-day delivery of Field Services supporting the client's operations across multiple regions
* Set the strategic direction of the program and manage to scope of work and change of scope
* Be accountable for Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and other contractual deliverables
* Manage customer expectations; ensure clarity of delivery commitments and prioritize to maximize value
* Own, investigate, and follow up on high-level escalations
* Chair internal and client-facing service delivery meetings; develop and deliver management-level presentations

**Governance, Risk & Operational Readiness**

* Define and maintain ongoing governance: reporting, monitoring, escalation, and controls
* Design, implement, and monitor ITIL processes (incident, request, change, problem management)
* Manage issues and risks across all service components; maintain risk matrices, dependencies, and timelines
* Define and write policies, controls, and SOPs per client needs and oversee implementation
* Define objectives and metrics; collect and analyze data to guide decision-making
* Conduct ticket audits, negative survey follow-ups, and other quality initiatives
* Address bottlenecks and balance security and business needs against team or technology constraints

**Continuous Improvement & Innovation**

* Sponsor and drive improvement activities; mature internal processes so teams deliver early and often
* Champion innovation and transformation, including automation, AI, and IT health monitoring tools
* Lead focus groups to improve processes and procedures; implement best business practices
* Identify opportunities to expand service offerings and support new business opportunities

**Financial & Vendor Management**

* Manage program financials to budget
* Assist with monthly client invoices; reconcile and approve vendor invoices
* Secure and manage 3rd-party vendor resources

**People Leadership**

* Hire Stefanini employees; establish expectations and provide leadership, direction, and coaching
* Drive cross-team efforts; remove impediments and shield teams from external interruptions
* Conduct one-on-ones and performance reviews; leverage recognition programs
* Create a cohesive team environment through consistent management
* Aid in corporate initiatives and perform other duties as assigned

Job Requirements
  
  
**Details:**
**Requirements**

* 7+ years of professional IT experience, including technical service management of Modern Endpoint and Digital Workplace services
* Hands-on or service-ownership experience with SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune, and JAMF
* Experience supporting M365 collaboration, Confluence, and Citrix virtual workplace environments
* Experience running vulnerability management and patch compliance programs for endpoint environments
* 5+ years managing Field Services teams, including deskside support, dispatch, IMAC, and hardware lifecycle
* Experience managing multi-site field operations and third-party field vendors to SLAs
* Familiarity with ITSM and field service tools (e.g., ServiceNow, CMDB, asset management systems)
* Experience managing teams supporting multi-region or multi-country operations is a plus
* Experience designing, implementing, and running ITIL core processes

* In-depth understanding of IT industry dynamics and service delivery processes

* Willingness to embrace innovative tools such as AI, automation, and IT health monitoring

* Ability to manage strategically and at a detailed level; high integrity with confidential matters
* Valid driver's license required

**Technical Competencies (General Understanding)**

* Windows and Linux operating environments
* Virtualization and infrastructure (VMware, Citrix, NetApp, Rubrik, Azure File Sync)
* Networking and network security (Cisco, Fortinet, DNS, load balancing)
* Security tools (Splunk SIEM, CrowdStrike EDR, AV, firewalls) and IAM (Active Directory, Archer GRC)
* Hybrid cloud (Azure) monitoring, storage, backup, and migration
* Modern endpoint management: SCCM/MECM, Intune, Autopilot, JAMF, OS deployment, and application packaging
* Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops / VDI
* Vulnerability management and patching tools (Tenable, Qualys, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike)
* M365 collaboration (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive) and Confluence/Atlassian
* IT asset and order management lifecycle
* Automation (RPA, Ansible) and AI concepts for service delivery

****Preferred****

* 3+ years of technical project management experience
* PMP, Prince2, or Agile certification
* Microsoft certifications (e.g., Endpoint Administrator, M365), JAMF, Citrix, or ITIL certification

****What You'll Get****

* Work with people who exhibit commitment to the client, leadership by example, respect for people, courage to innovate, and humbleness to learn
* Comprehensive benefits including 401(k), paid time off, tuition reimbursement, medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Professional development through Stefanini University eLearning and virtual training

* Brazilian and privately owned company

* Flat organizational structure enabling faster communication and decision making

At Stefanini, we value plurality and equity, regardless of race, sexual orientation, disability, age, ancestry, religion, gender, and nationality.

Title: Lead System Administrator
Description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About this role**

  

You will own internal IT end to end — identity and access, SaaS services, workstations and the corporate network that every colleague relies on daily. You'll lead a team of five administrators and take charge of the subscription budget, quarterly planning and renewals. We give you real decision-making authority: only spend above the limit, headcount or key vendor changes, risk acceptance and company-wide changes go up for approval. Everything else is your call, within the boundaries set out under "Decision Rights".

**You'll take ownership of:**

This is a hands-on lead role. Roughly 30% of your time goes to people, planning and alignment, and 70% to hands-on work: complex changes, incident investigation, configuration reviews, automation. You set up routine work so that it runs without you.

**1. Team and quarterly planning**

* Lead five administrators: 1:1s, goals, feedback. Run hiring for approved positions and, when necessary, parting ways — the latter agreed with your manager.
* Organize work across time zones: open incidents are handed over in writing to a specific person, and inconvenient hours are shared fairly. Three time zones cover about 13 hours of the working day, but not 24/7: you decide what truly requires a night-time or weekend response.
* Every critical system has a primary administrator and a backup who knows how to restore it.
* Each quarter, bring a plan: goals, owners, a support buffer and a list of what did not make the cut. Base it on feedback from engineers, recurring incidents and the renewal calendar. At the end of the quarter, show what was done, what was not and why. If urgent work comes up mid-quarter, say what moves and at what cost.
* Prepare a monthly report for the area: service and support health, access status, subscription spend and optimization results, key risks and items that need a management decision.

**2. Identity and access reviews**

* The identity provider is the central point of access provisioning: SSO, phishing-resistant MFA, role-based groups, SCIM. Hiring, transfers and terminations are triggered from the HR system.
* You verify revocation in the application itself. Deactivating a user in the identity provider does not end active sessions or revoke API tokens, local accounts and guest access. Systems without SCIM have an owner for manual revocation, and you make sure it is done.
* Access review frequency depends on risk: privileged and financial systems quarterly, everything else every six months. The system owner decides on each access, revocation is confirmed in the target system, and every exception has a reason and an expiry date. Results are retained as audit evidence.

**3. Corporate services and developer support**

* **Zero Trust access and DNS:** Zero Trust for internal tools (access policies, secure web gateway, device posture) and DNS for corporate domains. Policy changes roll out to a limited group first, and the on-call engineer has a rollback procedure. WAF and the product perimeter stay with DevOps.
* **Cloud, corporate side:** Cloud SSO integrated with the identity provider, role assignments agreed with DevOps, sandbox accounts, spend in corporate accounts. Organization structure and production belong to DevOps.
* **Corporate messaging:** Apps and integrations, guests and external channels, retention policies. Before a bot is installed, you know what data it reads and who owns it.
* **Collaboration suite:** Mail, calendar and documents: sharing rules, third-party OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, data transfer at offboarding.
* **Ticketing and knowledge base:** Permissions, projects and spaces, SSO sign-in. The ticketing system is the team's work queue, the knowledge base holds documentation.
* **Workstations:** MDM: encryption, updates, security policies, shipping a laptop to another country with zero-touch setup.
* Build self-service for developers: standard access is requested via chat or a ticket, approved by the resource owner and granted automatically for a limited time.
* Set support priorities: major outages and security incidents first, then requests that block teams from working.
* Together with DevOps, define clear ownership boundaries and drive shared requests to resolution: a ticket is closed when the problem is solved for the user, not when it has been handed to another team.

**4. Subscriptions and costs**

* Maintain the SaaS registry: owner, cost, number of seats, actual usage, renewal date and the last day the order can still be changed.
* Review paid seats separately from access reviews. Once a month, reconcile paid seats against activity. Long inactivity is a reason to check with the owner, not to reclaim the seat automatically: there are break-glass accounts and tools that are only needed once a quarter.
* Plan each contract review backwards from the last day the order can be changed or the renewal cancelled. By that day, the volume is agreed, the negotiation position is ready and the vendor has been notified if required. Example: 80 editor seats are paid for, 30 are actively used — we go to the vendor with 35 and a question about the pricing tier.
* Find shadow IT through OAuth grants and corporate card spend. In corporate cloud accounts, analyze bill growth by account and service together with the resource owner. Measure savings against invoices, separating realized savings from those expected at the next renewal.

**5. AI and automation**

For you, AI is the normal way the whole team works. What we expect:

* First-line support in chat: answers from the knowledge base with source links, request classification and ticket creation, handing unclear cases to a human.
* Preparation of access reviews and license reviews: AI reconciles exports from the identity provider, the HR system and applications and produces a list of anomalies for an administrator to verify.
* Measure the impact: compare time before and after rollout, including the time spent reviewing and correcting errors.
* Set the rules: what data may be shared with a model and where only a human makes the decision. AI does not grant privileged access or reset MFA: an administrator does that, verifying the employee's identity before any MFA reset.
* The whole team knows how to use these tools, not just you.
  

**About you:**

  

* **Leadership:** 2+ years of directly managing system administrators or IT engineers, including a distributed team. You have hired, given difficult feedback and changed priorities mid-quarter in a way the team understood.
* **Okta, in depth:** SSO, SCIM, lifecycle management, MFA policies, Workflows. You have implemented it or significantly restructured it, not just created users.
* **Cloudflare, AWS, Slack, at a working level:** Cloudflare Zero Trust and DNS; AWS IAM, IAM Identity Center, billing and Cost Explorer; Slack administration: apps, guests, Slack Connect. For each, you can walk us through a change you made yourself: how you tested it and what you did when something broke. Kubernetes, CI/CD and product networking are not required.

* Fintech or another regulated industry; PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001.
* Terraform for Okta, Cloudflare and AWS.
* Okta Identity Governance or similar, SaaS management platforms.

* **Rest & Recovery:** 24 days of annual leave, dedicated paid sick leave, and observance of Public Holidays to keep you at your best.

Title: Director of Information Technology
Description:

Our team of more than 1200 people work in environmental waste management and recovery, renewable energy, paving and construction, aggregates, and emulsions chemistries. We are a fifth-generation, family-owned company founded in 1887, operating from our base in the Niagara Region with facilities across Canada and the United States.
