Are you a technology visionary who knows how to turn innovation into business results? We're looking for a strategic IT leader ready to make an impact!

We are seeking an accomplished and forward-thinking Director of Information Technology to lead our organization's technology strategy, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and digital transformation initiatives. Reporting directly to the Executive Vice President, Finance & Chief Financial Officer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the organization's technology landscape, ensuring our systems, infrastructure, and digital capabilities support both current business operations and future growth.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic leader who can balance big-picture thinking with operational excellence. From strengthening our cybersecurity posture and modernizing enterprise systems to championing artificial intelligence and automation, you will help identify opportunities where technology can drive productivity, improve efficiencies, reduce costs, and create competitive advantages. Leading a talented team of 18 IT professionals, you will collaborate closely with executive leadership and business partners across the organization to develop and execute technology solutions that deliver measurable business value.

If you're passionate about innovation, thrive on solving complex challenges, and have the leadership skills to inspire high-performing teams, we'd love to hear from you!

**Location:**
Niagara Falls, Ontario

**Salary:**
$160,000–$180,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications

**Reports To:**
Executive Vice President, Finance & Chief Financial Officer

**Team Leadership:**
5 direct reports and 13 indirect reports

* Partner with executive leadership and business unit managers to translate business needs into technology priorities, identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and business performance.

Title: Strategic Account Manager
Description:
**About Orium**
---------------

Orium builds smart, modern commerce solutions for enterprise brands. We're the leading composable commerce consultancy and systems integrator in the Americas, with more composable launches than any firm in the region, and a member of the MACH Alliance. We combine AI, data and composable systems so people and intelligent agents can work together, and we partner with best-in-class technology providers including commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack across three lines of business: Commerce, DXP and Agentic.

We're a remote-first company with team members across the Americas. A certified BCorp for over a decade, we're based in Toronto, and in June 2024 we acquired the Mexico-based ecommerce agency Gluo.

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------

Orium is seeking a senior Strategic Account Manager to be the trusted partner for some of our most important enterprise clients. You'll own a small portfolio of complex accounts, be the person clients call when things get hard, and help them see their problems in a new way.

You're at your best in the room with senior stakeholders, whether you're leading a workshop, resetting expectations or making the case for what comes next. You'd rather go deep with a handful of clients than chase new logos, and you measure success by the trust you earn and the accounts you grow.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own 5 to 8 priority enterprise accounts as the main commercial contact and trusted advisor
* Act as the senior escalation point, leading honest conversations when expectations, scope or budgets need resetting, and getting relationships back on track
* Lead and participate in client workshops, steering committees, roadmap planning and quarterly business reviews, challenging assumptions and reframing problems when a client is heading the wrong way
* Drive account growth through renewals and expansion across our Commerce, DXP and Agentic practices, including partner-led opportunities with commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack
* Shape new opportunities with our delivery and strategy teams, from problem statement through pitch and SOW
* Help clients move from project work into ongoing optimization and managed services
* Develop and maintain account plans and forecasts in partnership with sales leadership
* Maintain strong working relationships with delivery teams to keep engagements on scope, high quality and aligned to client goals and KPIs
* Use AI tools for account research, meeting prep and opportunity spotting
* Travel to meet clients and partners across the Americas as needed

**Skills and Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* 5+ years in client-facing, revenue-accountable roles such as Account Director, Client Partner, Strategic Account Manager or Customer Success leader
* Experience at a professional services firm, agency, systems integrator or B2B SaaS company
* A track record of managing senior enterprise relationships through difficult moments, and coming out with more trust than before
* Experience working with B2B clients
* Confidence leading workshops and executive conversations, and the creativity to turn what a client asks for into a better problem to solve
* Proven ability to grow accounts through renewals and expansion, and comfort owning a revenue number
* Strong commercial judgment across scope, margin and forecast
* Knowledge of the digital commerce landscape, including composable commerce, modular DXP and emerging AI and agentic technologies, is an asset
* Experience with modern digital tools and an openness to integrating AI-powered solutions into your daily work\*
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-assisted decisions and workflows\*
* A mindset of continuous learning and the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and trends\*
* Based in Canada

* AI expectations will vary by role. Some positions focus on AI exploration and experimentation, while leadership roles may drive AI adoption and strategy.

**Is this Role a Fit for You?**
-------------------------------

The role emphasizes trusted client relationships, commercial acumen and creative problem solving. We value people with a maker's attitude, collaborative energy and entrepreneurial spirit. You'll find fulfillment in the role if you...

* **Are passionate about client relationships.** You can't sleep properly if we might miss a commitment, and you're the first to pick up the phone when something goes sideways.
* **Stay calm and direct in hard conversations.** You know that honest, well-timed conversations build more trust than avoiding them.
* **Love reframing the problem.** You get curious about the need behind the request and enjoy helping clients see a better path forward.
* **Have an interest in making the business work.** You're an entrepreneur at heart and see account growth as the result of delivering real value.
* **Prefer depth over volume.** You'd rather build long-term relationships with a few clients than chase new logos.
* **Thoroughly enjoy collaborative work.** You partner closely with delivery, strategy and sales, and you put the team's success first.
* **Are naturally curious about AI.** You look for ways to use AI and automation to work smarter, without losing the human touch.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Enjoy a flexible schedule of full-time hours. As a remote-first organization, we care about the work you do, but it's up to you to choose where and how you do it.
* Explore ongoing opportunities for professional development: training, conferences, certifications and in-house peer mentorship.
* Experiment with new techniques, wear multiple hats and learn about new disciplines.
* Pursue independent projects, explore new ideas and challenge yourself in your field with dedicated "Awesome Time" (self-directed professional development) annually and quarterly training budgets.
* On top of standard medical and dental coverage, we offer benefits like a parental leave top-up plan, an EAP, mental health coverage, virtual healthcare and a minimum vacation policy.
* Our Toronto HQ is a modern, ergonomic space with hotelling standing/sitting desks and an open-concept social atmosphere.
* Additional perks include in-house mindfulness sessions, remote group get-togethers and more!

The Canada base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $140,000 CAD, plus variable compensation of $30,000 - $40,000 CAD at target, for total On Target Earnings of $150,000 - $180,000 CAD. Orium lists this range in good faith, reflecting the expected compensation for this role in the specified locations as of this posting. The pay offered will depend on several relevant factors, such as education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, location and business needs. Please note, this range does not include any benefits that may be included as part of the total compensation package.

**Performance and Growth Expectations**
---------------------------------------

We emphasize accountability for outcomes, but autonomy in activities. Your work will be measured across a number of data points (peer, leader and project team feedback) and on the basis of client and user satisfaction. Your growth path is in your hands: you'll have ongoing meetings with your leader to help determine your path, but your progress will be based on what you hope to achieve and how you choose to access the resources available to you.

**Committed to an Inclusive Workplace**
---------------------------------------

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment as we build a workforce that reflects the diversity of the community in which we live, including those with disabilities. We are dedicated to providing accommodations in all parts of the hiring process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act and the Ontario Human Rights Code. If you require any accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs.

Orium uses AI tools for candidate communications, scheduling, interview notes and feedback summaries. Humans review all information and make every hiring decision.

**Committed to Social and Environmental Stewardship**
-----------------------------------------------------

Orium is committed to promoting and working towards a more socially and environmentally sustainable future. All employees are expected to make decisions and take actions in relation to their role and work that follow through on this commitment.

The Manager, IT Audit reports to the Director, IT Audit and is responsible for planning and executing risk-based technology audit and advisory engagements. This role focuses on assessing risks and controls across cloud environments, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, and enterprise technology platforms. • Experience working with cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and AI-related risks is required.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.

• Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.

• Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.

**Additional Information**
  
• Hybrid work model (3 days in office per week).

Title: Senior Manager, Technology Risk Officer
Description:
Requisition ID: 280235
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

The Senior Manager, Technology Risk is a first-line risk leader responsible for executing and sustaining technology risk management activities across assigned portfolios and domains. Reporting to the Director, Technology Risk Officer, this role partners closely with technology leaders, risk owners, and control functions to identify risks, assess control effectiveness, and drive remediation outcomes in alignment with risk appetite and regulatory expectations.

  

The role plays a critical part in operationalizing the Technology Risk Office’s strategy, translating risk direction, governance standards, and escalation decisions into consistent execution, high-quality evidence, and measurable risk reduction

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

* Execute technology risk assessments, control self-assessments, and thematic reviews across applications, platforms, and services, ensuring risks are accurately identified, evaluated, and documented in enterprise risk systems.
* Own day-to-day issue management and remediation execution, including development and tracking of clear get-to-green plans, addressing root causes, and escalating risks or slippage with proposed actions.
* Monitor the effectiveness of key technology governance processes (e.g., SDLC, change, architecture, and project delivery) to identify control gaps and support remediation and improvement initiatives.
* Support audit and regulatory activities by coordinating evidence, preparing responses, and validating remediation outcomes; oversee SOX-related control execution within scope, including evidence readiness for quarterly attestations.
* Produce risk, control, and remediation reporting (KPIs/KRIs), highlighting trends, emerging risks, and control health to support risk-based decision-making.
* Partner with technology risk owners, Business Internal Control teams, and other control functions to strengthen first-line risk ownership, execution consistency, and risk culture.
* Lead, coach, and develop Technology Risk Officers or analysts (where applicable) to ensure high-quality execution, sound judgment, and sustained risk management outcomes.
* Champion a customer-focused culture and deepen relationships with senior leadership, peers, and functional groups.
* Ensure compliance with information security regulations, user education, and cybersecurity.
* Lead the design and operation of compliance monitoring and improvement activities to ensure compliance with internal security policies and applicable laws and regulations.
* Actively pursue effective and efficient operations, ensuring adherence to operational risk, regulatory compliance risk, AML/ATF risk, and conduct risk frameworks.
* Understand and apply the organization’s risk appetite and risk culture in day-to-day activities and decisions.
* Build a high-performance environment and implement a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops, and motivates the team..

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

  

* University degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Technology, or a related field
* Professional certifications in cybersecurity, technology, or risk management (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, CEH, CISM).
* Demonstrated knowledge or hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:
  + Regulatory (e.g., FFIEC guidance, NYS DFS, FRB, FINRA)
  + Technology (e.g., cybersecurity, software delivery, infrastructure/platform services, asset or currency management)
  + Issue & Remediation Management (e.g., execution tracking, risk evaluation, escalation, and reporting)
  + Audit or Regulatory Exam Support (e.g., control testing, evidence management, remediation coordination)
* 7 to 10+ years of experience in technology risk, cybersecurity, internal controls, audit, compliance, or operational risk within a financial services or regulated environment.
* Broad exposure across multiple technology domains, such as application development, infrastructure or cloud services, information security, resilience, third-party risk, and change or incident management.
* Experience executing remediation programs and supporting get-to-green outcomes, including coordination across technology and control partners; experience across any line of defense is preferred.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly articulate risk issues, remediation status, and control gaps to technology leaders and control partners.
* Solid execution, governance, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, dependencies, and deadlines in a complex environment.
* Experience with risk reporting, metrics, or dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools) is desirable.
* Working knowledge of risk and control frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO, COBIT, ITIL, FFIEC) is desirable.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISM, CRISC, CISSP) are an asset but not required.

  

**What's in it for you?**

  

* Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
* Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
* Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
* Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
* Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons, contests, Humans of Digital and much more.

  

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto
  
  
Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.
  
  
At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. Description:
#### **Job Description**

Husky TechnologiesTM a company with a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships, a strong sense of community and a unique culture and values. We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy.

At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM Canadian manufacturing facilities and global headquarters are located in Bolton, Ontario on a large, beautiful campus located just 20 minutes north of Toronto’s Pearson International Airport. Features include a fitness and wellness center, intramural sports activities, on-site cafeteria, and clean, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment and competitive total compensation package, including above market retirement savings plan and market competitive group benefits.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  

The IT Project Manager is a member of the Agile Delivery & Project Management team within the Digital Services Team (DST). The role reports to the Manager, Agile Delivery. The IT Project Manager leads multiple concurrent technology projects across the Enterprise Data Platform, Data & Analytics, master data, mobile and field-service enablement, operational reporting, and emerging AI-enabled capabilities.

Working with business leaders, Steering Committees, technical teams and external vendors, the IT Project Manager is accountable for delivering projects that achieve their intended business outcomes. All work is completed in accordance with the DST PMO project management model, governance standards, and controlled templates.

**Key Responsibilities/Areas of Accountability**

* Own end-to-end project delivery—from kickoff through go-live—ensuring alignment with business outcomes and DST PMO best practices.
* Work with sponsors and business stakeholders to define scope, measurable success criteria, baselines and expected benefits. Track benefit realization after go-live.
* Build and maintain integrated project plans that reflect dependencies, critical paths and named resource allocations. Re-forecast proactively and transparently when conditions change.
* Negotiate resource allocations, manage shared and constrained teams, and bring trade-offs and sequencing decisions to leadership with clear options.
* Coordinate SOWs and hold partners accountable to their commitments.
* Maintain project governance, including RAID registers, decision logs, weekly Project Status Updates and Steering Committee reporting. Apply the governance profile appropriate to project size and risk.
* Own budgets, forecasts, and variance reporting.
* Escalate risks and issues early to sponsors and Steering Committees, with a clear statement of impact and a recommended course of action.
* Engage Architecture Review, Financial Controls/ITGC and Audit/SOX requirements early where applicable.
* Partner with business and change leads on training, communication and readiness activities to support adoption.
* Apply Agile, Waterfall or Hybrid delivery approaches as appropriate, keeping governance proportionate to project size and risk.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of PMO practices, templates and lessons learned.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Degree or diploma in Information Technology, Business or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience managing IT projects end to end, including multiple concurrent projects across business and technical teams.
* Demonstrated success delivering projects with shared resources, competing priorities and vendor dependencies.
* Experience managing third-party vendors and offshore or nearshore partners.
* Strong working knowledge of project governance, including stage gates, RAID management, decision logs, Steering Committee reporting and financial tracking.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present status, risks and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
* Sound judgment in prioritization, escalation and re-planning, with strong follow-through to closure.
* Working knowledge of Agile and traditional delivery methodologies.
* Proficiency with Planview (or a comparable portfolio management tool), Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, Excel and Microsoft 365/Teams.

**Assets**

* Experience delivering data and analytics projects, such as data platforms, master data management, Power BI or reporting tools, and cloud data services.
* Experience with ERP, manufacturing, service or mobile/field-enablement solutions.
* Exposure to AI or automation initiatives.
* Experience applying Audit/SOX, ITGC or data governance controls within project delivery.
* Project management certification, such as PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM/PSM or equivalent.

Pay Range: $96,000 - $120,000

Vacancy: Replacement

We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Title: Product Operations Manager II (Voice and Wifi)

Build a foundation of excellence through metrics, business processes, best practices, budgeting, and reporting.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES AT ALL LEVELS:**

* Evaluate and analyze consumer and partner interactions with products and services.
* Implement operational improvements for product lines based on analysis of service performance.
* Collect, analyze, and interpret user data, product usage metrics, and customer feedback to identify trends and opportunities for improvement on all products in the market within assigned domain.

Title: Vice President, Core Infrastrucutre
Location: Global Village, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Description:
***Posting Type***
Hybrid
  
  
**Job Overview**
Rel aiR is the high-scale, secure, and defensible platform where legal data lives. It runs on infrastructure that has to be available, economical, and compliant in every region we serve. We hold more than 100 petabytes of customer data today, and we are building for hundreds of petabytes in the next three years, scaling potentially to an exabyte within five. This is sensitive data at scale, and managing it requires a global understanding of data management.
  
  
The load is rising from multiple directions at once. More legal work is being done with the help of AI-driven software. AI is supporting more use cases across Legal Data Intelligence. MCP (Model Context Protocol) and third-party builder programs are automating more workflows. And we are moving all new matters to Rel aiR. Together these have taken the AI results we produce from millions to hundreds of millions, and we are headed to billions.
  
  
We are hiring a Vice President of Core Infrastructure to build the foundation for that growth and to join the leadership team of Engineering at Relativity. You will own SQL platform, compute (Kubernetes), reliability and operations, and incident and problem management, and build a new capacity-forecasting function.
  
  
Your strategy will span multiple data centers and multiple ways to store data. You will stay agile when cloud storage capacity is tight, adapt to data sovereignty and local requirements around the world, and work with Security to keep the fortress secure. You will work with engineering teams to raise utilization and route work to the resources available, and you will make sure we use services that meet our economic targets, and use them well.
  
  
**Job Description And Requirements**
**This is a builder’s job.**
We are 25 years old and, in many ways, still a startup. We are growing fast, and the infrastructure we need for the next five years does not exist yet. You will not inherit a mature platform to operate. You will build the strategy, the talent, and the capacity engine while the platform carries production traffic. Our Cloud Native Transformation is re-platforming Rel aiR so that every matter, including the largest and most complex, runs on a cloud-native foundation, and it depends on what you will lead. We need your help to build it and to execute it.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**

* Reliability customers can feel. Availability and recovery that match the trust customers place in us, with fewer severe incidents and faster resolution.
* Infrastructure with options. Storage and compute across multiple data centers and multiple ways to store data, with the agility to shift when cloud capacity is constrained.
* Global by design. Data placement and operations that meet data sovereignty and local requirements wherever our customers are.
* A secure fortress. Infrastructure and security decisions made together, with a close and trusted relationship between your organization and Security.
* Efficient use of capacity. Engineering teams use resources more fully, work routes to the capacity that is available, and the services we choose meet our economic targets and are used appropriately.
* Infrastructure that carries the transformation. The data and compute platform keeps pace with the Cloud Native Transformation, and structural change ships in steady increments.
* One owner from detection to fix. Incident response and problem management sit in one organization, and the same root causes stop recurring.
* A strong teammate across Engineering. You help set direction beyond your own domain and are known as a leader inside the company and across the industry.

**What You’ll Do**

* Set the vision. Define what infrastructure for a leading data company looks like, and bring your organization and your peers along.
* Own reliability end to end. Observability, site services, on-call, incident response, and problem management sit with you.
* Build the storage and compute strategy. Multiple data centers, multiple storage options, and the capacity model that shows where each choice breaks as data grows toward an exabyte.
* Manage cost as part of the job. Own the economics of the services we use, and work with Finance on how storage and AI costs affect gross margin.
* Partner with Security. Keep the fortress secure through shared priorities, shared roadmaps, and clear ownership.
* Work with engineering teams. Raise utilization, route work to available resources, and adapt to cloud storage availability and to local requirements.
* Build the organization. Recruit the leaders, set the operating rules, and decide the mix of in-house and contract teams.
* Lead across Engineering. Work daily with the leaders of data pipelines, security, AI products, and the builder platform, and take a seat in decisions that reach beyond your domain.
* Use AI to run production. Apply AI to detection, root-cause analysis, and remediation.
* Stay in touch with the details. Operate comfortably at 1,000 feet and at ground level. Go deep on a root-cause analysis or a customer escalation and find the cause. Walk to a whiteboard and sketch the architecture, including where it breaks.

**Required**
**What You Bring**

* A builder’s record. You have built strategy and talent in a fast-growing company, not only operated a mature platform.
* SaaS operations at scale. A record of running infrastructure and site reliability for a multi-tenant SaaS platform with demanding availability commitments and petabytes of customer data.
* Global data management. Experience placing and operating sensitive data across multiple regions and data centers, and meeting data sovereignty and local requirements.
* Infrastructure leadership. Led organizations of 100+ engineers across SRE, database platform, and container platform disciplines, including contractor teams.
* Cost and capacity economics. You have managed infrastructure cost against economic targets, and made build-versus-buy decisions on storage or compute at petabyte scale.
* Cloud-native depth. Kubernetes, SQL at scale, and a major public cloud. Hyperscale cloud provider experience is valuable.
* Incident leadership. You have reduced severe incidents and time to resolve in a large organization.
* Technical credibility. You can challenge an architecture, a capacity forecast, and an incident review on the merits.

**Valuable But Not Required**

* Regulated or FedRAMP-authorized environments.
* Experience with eDiscovery or other large document platforms.

Title: Executive Director, Utilities (RE1)
Description:
The Executive Director, Utilities leads the City Operations utilities mandate across Qiddiya City, covering power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, ICT, water bodies, lagoons and other utility systems within scope. The role is accountable for improving the operational management and resilience of existing interim networks, water bodies and lagoons; protecting continuity of service during construction; defining the city-wide utilities strategy, ownership model and operating standards; and ensuring permanent utility and water assets are planned, designed, delivered and accepted in line with City Operations and Qiddiya City Authority requirements. Reporting to the City Chief Operations Officer, the role coordinates closely with planning, design, delivery, district and asset teams, QTech, Smart City, utility providers, regulators and O&M partners to manage material service, capacity, water-quality, commercial and reputational risks.

**Utilities Strategy and Asset Ownership**

* Develop and implement the City Operations strategy for all utilities, water bodies and lagoons, including service outcomes, water quality, resilience, governance, ownership, operating and cost model, standards and long-term investment priorities.
* Determine which interim and permanent utility assets will be adopted by City Operations and which will be owned or operated by utilities, districts, assets or other third parties, with clear decision rights and accountability.
* Improve the operational management, asset information, condition oversight and service performance of existing interim power, potable water, renewed water and ICT networks.
* Develop and implement a protection and continuity strategy for live interim utility networks during construction, recognising that outages create a material operational and reputational risk for Qiddiya.
* Maintain an accurate city-wide utilities asset register and GIS record, including surveys of existing interim networks and requirements for any relocation arising from development works.
* Advise the City Chief Operations Officer and governance on utility priorities, delivery dependencies, capacity constraints, temporary solutions, investment needs and material operational risks.

**Planning, Design and Operational Assurance**

* Coordinate with planning, design and delivery teams to accelerate permanent utility assets needed for growing city-wide operational, development and major-event requirements.
* Define City Operations requirements and assure their incorporation into utility strategies, project briefs, designs, specifications, delivery plans and permanent-asset operating models.
* Verify that interim and full-build infrastructure can meet peak utility loads, including concurrent major-event scenarios and increased city footfall, with adequate redundancy and recovery arrangements.
* Lead operational assurance of critical dependencies and interfaces, including permanent and temporary power, potable and renewed water capacity, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, utility corridors, ICT connectivity and data-centre requirements.
* Coordinate space planning for utility operational centres, O&M yards, workshops and equipment and spare-parts storage, confirming the required number, location and functionality across Qiddiya City.
* Participate in multidisciplinary stage-gate reviews and challenge solutions to optimise safety, service continuity, maintainability, whole-life cost, efficiency and operational readiness.

**Readiness, Handover and Asset Acceptance**

* Establish utility readiness, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance requirements, including permits, asset data, GIS records, operating procedures, warranties, spares, training and defect closure.
* Assess acceptance evidence and recommend City Operations acceptance only where ownership, operating responsibility, funding and service interfaces are clear.
* Aggregate city-wide O&M requirements and lead the technical and operational strategy for a multi-year city-wide utilities O&M services procurement, coordinating with Commercial, Procurement, Finance and Legal.
* Coordinate mobilisation and transition arrangements for interim and permanent networks, including temporary service extensions where delays to permanent assets require continued use of temporary power, water or ICT solutions.
* Ensure adopted assets are captured in the asset management system and GIS with complete, accurate and usable information for safe operation and maintenance.

**Performance, Risk and Lifecycle Management**

* Establish KPIs and executive reporting for availability, outages, reliability, water quality, water-body and lagoon condition, capacity, losses, consumption, compliance, incidents, cost, complaints and recovery performance.
* Maintain a consolidated utilities risk and dependency register covering delivery slippage, temporary-network fragility, corridor and land constraints, capacity shortfalls, construction interfaces and unbudgeted temporary solutions.
* Develop lifecycle, renewal and investment plans based on criticality, condition, service demand, resilience, regulatory requirements and whole-life value.
* Confirm the operational data required for smart utilities, align the Siemens utilities integration study with QTech and Smart City initiatives, and define requirements for monitoring, analytics and future digital-twin capability.
* Ensure emergency, outage, business continuity and recovery plans are coordinated with City Operations, districts, assets, utility providers, safety, security and event functions.

**Commercial, Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Define the utilities cost-recovery model, including cost allocation, metering, tariffs or charges, billing inputs, subsidy requirements, subsidy period and governance for costs levied on operational assets.
* Lead the utility component of the city service charge in collaboration with the Executive Director, City Asset Management and Finance and Control, ensuring transparent and auditable recovery mechanisms.
* Draft and implement service level agreements between City Operations and districts or assets for utilities adopted by City Operations, including service standards, responsibilities, escalation, outage communication and performance reporting.
* Develop City Operations codes, standards and guidelines for construction in the vicinity of live utility assets, including permits, protection measures, access controls and incident response.
* Manage strategic interfaces with authorities, regulators, Saudi Electricity, water entities, telecoms providers, developers, districts, operators and specialist O&M service providers.
* Ensure statutory, technical, environmental, commercial and contractual obligations are identified, governed and evidenced across all adopted utilities.

**Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build and lead a capable municipal utilities team with clear accountability, effective governance and disciplined delivery.
* Develop Saudi talent through structured recruitment, mentoring, role exposure, succession planning and knowledge transfer from advisers, delivery partners and operators.
* Promote collaboration, technical rigour, commercial discipline, innovation and continuous improvement.

  
**Requirements**

**Education and Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, utilities, infrastructure, asset management or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in engineering, asset management, business or a related field is advantageous.
* Relevant professional registration or accreditation in engineering, utilities, asset management or project management is preferred.

**Experience**

* Substantial executive leadership experience in city-wide utilities, infrastructure asset management or utility network development within a complex city, municipality, mixed-use destination or major development programme.
* Demonstrated experience managing live interim or temporary utility networks while permanent infrastructure is planned and delivered in an active construction environment.
* Strong experience across utility strategy, planning, design assurance, construction interfaces, testing, commissioning, handover, operational acceptance and service mobilisation.
* Proven experience in network resilience, outage management, peak-demand planning, lifecycle investment, GIS and asset information, operational data and regulatory compliance.
* Demonstrated experience developing utility O&M procurement strategies, SLAs, performance regimes, tariffs, metering, billing, cost-recovery or subsidy models.
* Proven ability to manage interfaces among developers, delivery teams, authorities, regulators, utilities, districts, operators and service providers; experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC is strongly preferred.

**Technical and Functional Expectations**

* Expert understanding of city-wide utility asset management, live-network operations and governance of networked infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, ICT and associated corridors, facilities and operational dependencies.
* Ability to assess demand, capacity, reliability, redundancy, pressure and flow constraints, metering, efficiency, service continuity, emergency recovery and whole-life cost.
* Strong understanding of GIS, asset registers, operational technology, smart-utility data, analytics and digital-twin opportunities.
* Clear understanding of asset-owner, developer, regulator, network operator, O&M manager, district, asset and service-provider accountability boundaries.
* Strong commercial judgement, procurement capability, risk management, data-led decision-making and executive reporting.

Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.

Ellucian is seeking a dynamic **Senior Director of Professional Services Delivery** to join our Professional Services organization. This role involves leading and overseeing the implementation of Ellucian solutions, supporting higher education institutions in Canada and the eastern United States. These strategic programs range from 1.5 to 2 years. Bring your strategic vision, enterprise program governance, execution, and leadership skills to Ellucian and make a significant impact! At Ellucian, we offer a comprehensive SaaS portfolio that helps higher education institutions navigate change, achieve transparency, and drive efficiency.

**Where You Will Make an Impact**

* Manage the Professional Services Field Delivery organization.
* Share responsibility for the North American Professional Services P&L (revenue and expenses of assigned projects) and Customer Satisfaction.
* Own financial forecasts related to delivery revenue and margin, collaborating closely with the Finance Business Partner.
* Identify business growth opportunities by leveraging knowledge of the Higher Education industry, business processes, and software products.
* Assist the Customer Success team in developing solutions and selling the value of project management services during the sales cycle.
* Drive consumption of PS orders (backlog) to accelerate time to value and maximize project profitability.
* Ensure effective execution of service delivery and achievement of customers’ desired outcomes.
* Implement project quality assurance by employing standardized processes and best practices.
* Assess risks, define mitigation plans, manage demand, and anticipate resource bottlenecks.
* Establish early-warning project management and risk management practices.
* Provide critical issue management and proactively lead project escalations, implementing measures to prevent future issues.
* Drive the vision and execution of Professional Services.
* Build strong, long-lasting relationships with customers, delivering high-value, outcome-based services that result in referenceable clients.
* Motivate, coach, and transform the Delivery team to an outcomes-based service model, delivering high NPS and project profitability.
* Promote the use of blended delivery (e.g., using Ellucian CoEs in India and Mexico or partners/subcontractors).
* Proactively engage with the North American Professional Services organization consulting practices to ensure timely delivery to contract and customer satisfaction/NPS.
* Resolve escalations by leading cross-functional team resolutions to mitigate project risks and issues.
* Monitor the health status of the Delivery region and ensure proactive risk management.
* Improve NA regional delivery team dynamics and performance through leadership, mentoring, and motivation.
* Ensure regions leverage repeatable, standard practices/processes.
* Understand the Professional Services marketplace and drive new implementation approaches throughout the organization.
* Work collaboratively with the Services team to develop and improve strategies, policies, and procedures; support and promote the use of delivery methodologies and best practices.

**Developing Our Teams**

* Lead change management activities within the Field Delivery organization to enable transformation and team growth.
* Address performance concerns with delivery leaders and provide timely performance evaluation input.
* Focus on proactive communications, cascading messages through regional leadership.
* Own the accuracy of the regional financial forecasting process (revenue, bookings, margins, expenditures, etc.).
* Monitor regional delivery KPIs (supply & demand, backlog, project profitability, PM utilization, and project health).
* Establish and monitor delivery compliance and assurance metrics underpinning project health.
* Foster a culture of skills development and employee career advancement.
* Build positive working relationships with Sales, Pre-sales, Customer Success & Support, Cloud Operations, Managed Services teams, and the Office of the COO, operating under the “One-team” approach motto across Ellucian to enhance customer service excellence.

**What You Will Bring**

* + A minimum of 12 years of progressive professional experience, including personnel management, technical leadership, and P&L ownership.
  + Demonstrable experience in resource planning and optimization; revenue recognition and EBITDA budgeting, and action planning resulting from actively managing budgets, costs, and performance.
  + Consulting or leadership position in a Professional Service Organization of a SaaS software company is required, with specific experience in moving applications from on-prem to Cloud/SaaS.
  + Project Management and Operations experience in running Professional Services in software companies.
  + Demonstrable experience in interfacing commercially and technically with partner organizations, outsourcing companies, and global coordination of remote resources and contractors.

Title: Lead Power Systems Engineer - Data Centres
Description:
The Lead Power Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the electrical power systems engineering scope of Digital EPC projects from concept and detailed design through procurement, construction, testing, commissioning and final handover. The role ensures that utility interfaces, substations, medium- and low-voltage distribution, standby generation, UPS systems, energy storage, protection, grounding and power-quality solutions are safe, reliable, resilient and fully aligned with the operational requirements of mission-critical digital infrastructure.

The position provides discipline leadership for data centres, ICT facilities, telecommunications hubs, command-and-control environments, smart infrastructure and other technology-intensive developments. The Lead Power Systems Engineer coordinates engineers, designers, specialist consultants, OEMs, vendors, construction teams, systems integrators and client representatives while managing interfaces with mechanical, structural, ICT, ELV, controls and commissioning functions.

The role safeguards engineering quality and power-system resilience through disciplined design governance, technical studies, equipment specification, protection coordination, redundancy analysis, vendor review and change control. It resolves complex engineering issues and ensures that electrical systems support phased energization, integrated systems testing, reliability objectives and operational handover.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Power Systems Engineering Leadership**

Lead planning, execution and technical assurance of the power systems scope, establishing design priorities, deliverable schedules, resource requirements and quality expectations.

**2. Electrical Architecture & Resilience Design**

Direct development of utility intake, substation, MV/LV distribution, standby generation, UPS, energy-storage and redundant power architectures aligned with availability and operational requirements.

**3. Power System Studies & Protection Coordination**

Oversee load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc-flash, harmonic, grounding, motor-starting and reliability studies and ensure findings are incorporated into the design.

**4. Equipment Specification & Procurement Engineering**

Prepare and review specifications, datasheets, requisitions, technical bid evaluations and vendor documents for transformers, switchgear, generators, UPS, batteries, busways, panels and related equipment.

**5. Multidiscipline & Digital Systems Interfaces**

Manage interfaces with mechanical cooling, ICT, ELV, controls, BMS, DCIM, civil, structural, architectural, construction and commissioning disciplines.

**6. Energy Efficiency, Power Quality & Capacity Planning**

Optimize system capacity, efficiency, power factor, harmonic performance, energy monitoring and future expansion without compromising resilience or maintainability.

**7. Constructability & Site Engineering Support**

Lead constructability reviews and resolve technical queries, field changes, nonconformities, installation issues and energization constraints while protecting design intent.

**8. Engineering Quality, Safety & Compliance**

Ensure calculations, drawings and specifications are checked, verified and approved under quality procedures, authority requirements, electrical codes and contractual obligations.

**9. Testing, Energization & Commissioning Support**

Lead technical readiness for factory and site testing, protection testing, energization, integrated systems testing, failure-mode demonstrations, defect closure and handover.

**10. Team Development & Technical Coordination**

Guide power systems engineers and designers, allocate work, review performance, share technical knowledge and maintain effective stakeholder communication.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

**Power Systems Engineering Experience: Minimum 12+ years in design and project delivery**

Progressive experience in electrical power systems for data centres, ICT facilities, telecommunications, mission-critical infrastructure, utilities or technology-intensive EPC projects.

**Discipline Leadership Experience: Minimum 5+ years leading electrical or power systems teams**

Responsibility for architecture, studies, equipment packages, design reviews, vendor coordination, multidisciplinary interfaces and engineering quality.

**Critical Power & Commissioning Experience: Minimum 5+ years across procurement, construction and testing**

Experience translating resilience requirements into equipment, installation, protection, energization, integrated testing and operational-handover solutions.

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**

**1. Critical Power Architecture**

Advanced knowledge of utility supplies, substations, MV/LV distribution, generators, UPS, batteries, transfer systems and redundancy configurations for digital infrastructure.

**2. Power System Analysis & Protection**

Strong command of load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc-flash, harmonic, grounding and reliability studies under relevant international standards.

**3. Electrical Equipment & Vendor Management**

Ability to define requirements, evaluate bids, review vendor designs, manage deviations and coordinate manufacture, inspection, testing and delivery of critical equipment.

**4. Digital Infrastructure & Systems Integration**

Ability to integrate electrical systems with cooling, ICT, BMS, DCIM, controls, metering, security and operational monitoring platforms.

**5. Technical Leadership & Problem Solving**

Strong analytical, communication and decision-making capability to resolve complex power-system issues and align multidisciplinary stakeholders.

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a closely related Engineering discipline

• Professional Engineering registration, chartered status, or equivalent professional qualification preferred

• Master's degree in Electrical Power Systems, Energy, or a related Engineering field advantageous

• Relevant certification or advanced training in data-centre power, protection, power quality, energy management, or project management advantageous

• Training in applicable international electrical codes, power-system analysis software, HSE, or quality management preferred

**TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**

**Power System Architecture & Distribution:**

Designs and reviews utility intake, substations, MV/LV networks, transformers, switchgear, generators, UPS, batteries, busways and resilient distribution systems.

**Power System Studies & Protection:**

Performs and reviews load flow, short-circuit, discrimination, arc-flash, harmonic, grounding, motor-starting and reliability studies.

**Critical Power & Redundancy Engineering:**

Develops and verifies redundancy, maintainability, failure-mode, capacity and availability strategies for mission-critical digital infrastructure.

**Equipment, Construction & Energization Engineering:**

Controls vendor documentation and resolves installation, testing, protection, nonconformance, field-change and energization matters.

**Digital Power Monitoring & Technical Documentation:**

Integrates metering, power monitoring, BMS and DCIM requirements and uses engineering-data and document-control systems to maintain approved deliverables.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage operating schedules and preventive and corrective maintenance across assigned plants, pumping stations, storage and networks.
* Oversee TSE supply and reuse interfaces, potable water distribution, and wastewater collection and treatment within agreed service boundaries.
* Monitor water quality, treatment performance, pressure, consumption, losses and capacity, coordinating investigations and corrective actions.
* Supervise operational teams and contractors against agreed safety, quality, service and maintenance standards.
* Coordinate planned interruptions, supply failures, blockages, overflows and service recovery with responsible operators and stakeholders.
* Review commissioning and handover evidence, track defects and warranties, and recommend asset readiness and renewal priorities.
Maintain accurate asset and maintenance records, monitor expenditure and provide validated performance and risk reporting.  

  
  
**Requirements**

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Environmental, Chemical, Civil or Water Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* **7+ years’ experience** in water and wastewater operations and maintenance, including management of TSE and potable water services, wastewater collection or treatment, and supervision of operational teams or contractors.
* Experience managing maintenance programmes across large estates, mixed-use developments or comparable complex portfolios.
* Experience in water-quality monitoring, treatment performance, contractor supervision, budget monitoring, handover and incident coordination.
* Any mandatory registration or operating authorisation must match the assigned duties.

**Preferred / Desirable**

* Relevant postgraduate qualification in water and wastewater engineering, maintenance or asset management.
* Relevant professional engineering accreditation, where appropriate.
* Certification in water and wastewater operations, treatment, water quality, maintenance or asset management.

Title: MANAGER, CUSTOMER TECHNOLOGY IMPLEMENTATIONS
Description:
**WHO WE ARE**

GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential.

Through our unique integrated payer-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.  
  
At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

**THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL**

GreenShield is seeking a customer-focused and experienced Manager, Customer Technology Implementations to lead the delivery of customer-facing technology implementations across the organization.

Reporting to the Director, Technology Project Management Office, this role will oversee a team of technology project managers responsible for coordinating complex implementations for new and existing customers and partners. The portfolio will include implementations supporting GreenShield’s Third Party Administration business, white-labelled GS+ solutions, new customer onboarding, Single Sign-On integrations, API integrations, customer migrations, and other technology-enabled partner solutions.

The Manager will provide clear leadership and accountability across the full implementation lifecycle, from early intake, discovery, requirements definition, and planning through build, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations. The role will work closely with customers and with internal Sales, Client Services, Product, Engineering, Security, Operations, and business teams to ensure commitments are well understood, delivery risks are addressed early, and customers receive a coordinated and professional implementation experience.

This is a highly visible, externally facing leadership role. The successful candidate will have significant experience working directly with customers, will communicate with confidence and credibility, and will be comfortable representing GreenShield in complex or sensitive implementation discussions. They will bring the judgment, executive presence, and delivery discipline required to balance customer expectations with technology capacity, solution constraints, contractual commitments, and organizational priorities.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Lead GreenShield’s delivery of customer-facing technology implementations, including Third Party Administration solutions, GS+ white labelling, new customer onboarding, SSO, API integrations, and other partner technology solutions.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of technology project managers, providing day-to-day people leadership, performance management, ensuring consistent standards for customer engagement, delivery planning, risk management, communication, and execution.

* Serve as the senior Technology PMO representative with customers and partners, building trusted relationships and leading key governance, status, decision, and escalation discussions.

* Provide end-to-end oversight from intake and discovery through requirements, planning, build, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations.

* Develops, standardizes and continuously improves implementation playbooks, estimation models, templates and documentation standards to ensure a consistent, positive client experience across all segments and reduce reliance on ad hoc or contractor-only knowledge.

* Ensure customer commitments are supported by clear requirements, defined scope, realistic delivery plans, appropriate resourcing, and alignment between contractual obligations and technology capabilities.

* Partner with Sales, Onboarding, Product, Engineering, Security, Operations, and business teams to establish clear ownership, effective handoffs, and coordinated delivery.

* Proactively manage implementation risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes, and customer concerns, escalating decisions and initiating recovery plans when required.

* Establish and continuously improve a consistent and scalable customer implementation methodology, including intake, stage gates, governance, documentation, readiness criteria, and performance reporting.

* Maintain an integrated view of the implementation portfolio, balancing customer priorities with delivery capacity and providing leadership with clear visibility into progress, risks, resource constraints, and required decisions.

* Champion a professional, transparent, and customer-focused delivery experience that improves implementation predictability, customer confidence, and speed to value.

 **WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Experience and education**

* University degree or college diploma in business, technology, project management, engineering, or a related discipline.

* PMP certification or equivalent is preferred.

* 8+ years of technology project or program management experience, including complex customer implementations, with at least 3 years leading project managers or implementation professionals.

* Proven experience overseeing concurrent customer implementations and establishing effective governance, capacity planning, delivery standards, and portfolio reporting.

* Strong customer and business acumen, with the judgment to balance commercial commitments, customer expectations, technical feasibility, scope, risk, and delivery capacity.

* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead multidisciplinary teams across business and technology functions.

* Exceptional customer-facing, executive communication, negotiation, presentation, and escalation-management skills.

* Strong proficiency with project delivery and collaboration tools, including AI-powered tools that improve planning, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

* Collaborative and results-oriented leadership style, with the ability to succeed in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

**To succeed in this role**

* Significant experience leading complex, customer-facing technology implementations, ideally in health care, insurance, benefits administration, financial services, SaaS, or another regulated environment.

* Demonstrated success leading and developing project managers or implementation professionals while managing multiple concurrent priorities.

* Strong end-to-end technology delivery experience across requirements, integrations, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations.

* Proven ability to build trusted relationships with customers, partners, vendors, and senior stakeholders; set realistic expectations; and lead difficult conversations or escalations with confidence.

* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for customer, business, and executive audiences.

* Strong business acumen, delivery discipline, and influence across cross-functional teams, with the ability to balance customer commitments, technology capacity, risks, and organizational priorities.

**Preferred experience**

* PMP, PgMP, Agile, Prosci, ITIL, or related professional certification.

* Experience with third-party benefits administration or insurance administration technology.

* Experience delivering SaaS products or technology solutions for external customers.

* Knowledge of digital health, benefits, claims, enrollment, billing, identity, or customer portal solutions.

* Experience working with cloud platforms, integration technologies, APIs, identity platforms, and enterprise security requirements.

* Experience establishing or maturing a customer implementation methodology or implementation services function.

* Bilingualism in English and French.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

**Base Salary:** CAD $94,406.00 - 142,069.00  
**Offer positioning:** Determined using relevant experience, skills, internal equity and current market data.  
**Total rewards:** Health and dental coverage, retirement savings, paid time off and well-being support (up to $10,000 per year for mental health).  
**Posting disclosures:** This is for an existing vacancy.  
**Work model:** Hybrid

**THE CULTURE**  
We believe a career should be meaningful. Not just a means to earn a living. Our culture is one where everyone's voice is heard and valued. Because that’s what it takes to create better health for all. We dare to challenge the status quo. And we’re driven by people who have challenged theirs. We believe that your workplace should empower you to be the best version of yourself. That’s why we provide a place where you can be inspired, challenged, and rewarded.  
  
Where your growth means our growth.  
Where your voice is heard and valued.  
Where your work has purpose. And purpose matters.  
  
We believe our people are critical to our overall success. Inclusivity makes us a stronger, smarter and more informed organization. Being intentionally inclusive of diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences will enhance our company culture to positively impact how we support our communities. A career at GreenShield isn’t just about personal achievements, it's about making a difference together.  
  
Here’s to Better Health for All!

**A FEW MORE DETAILS**  
Proficiency in English is required for this position. As part of this role, you will be required to communicate with colleagues or customers who use English as their primary language. By requiring English proficiency for this position, we aim to ensure that our employees can excel in their roles, collaborate, and communicate effectively, and contribute to the success of our organization.

GS supports diversity, equity and inclusion in our teams and communities, and we value the unique contributions made by all. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly to every requirement, we invite you to apply. We encourage applications from all candidates and will accommodate needs under human rights legislation throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. Please let us know of any accommodation through requestforaccommodation@greenshield.ca. Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

* Superviser l’intégration d’OFS avec les modules Oracle Fusion SCM, Finance et Service, en assurant un flux de données et un alignement des processus harmonisés.

* Solides compétences en analytique et en résolution de problèmes.

* Une expérience dans les domaines de la gestion de puits, du pétrole et du gaz ou dans des domaines connexes est hautement souhaitable.

Le bilinguisme en français et en anglais est requis pour ce poste en raison de la nature du rôle ayant des interactions avec les clients et les équipes de projet nationaux et mondiaux.

Title: Deals, Delivering Deal Value, Manager
Description:
A career within Delivering Deal Value (DDV) will provide you with the opportunity to help clients achieve maximum value on their deal transactions by solving transformational and other complex challenges. We focus on all operational aspects of a transaction – pre- and post-close – including pre-deal and functional due diligence, enterprise-wide integrations, and complex divestitures, carve-outs and separations. Our work spans across a wide range of functional and cross-functional areas, within diverse sectors and industries. As a DDV Manager, you will join a dynamic team of problem solvers dedicated to helping clients navigate complex business challenges — from strategy through execution. You will play a key role in driving value across the full deal lifecycle, partnering with other competencies within PwC’s Deals line of business in order to serve clients in delivering measurable results in high-stakes transactions.

**The Opportunity:**

Our team assists Corporate, Private Equity and Pension Fund clients in their acquisition, integration, and divestiture activity. This team supports clients in all operational aspects of a deal, pre- and post-completion, including:

* Buy- and sell-side functional due diligence (i.e. Operations, HR, Tech, Cyber, etc.)
* Post-acquisition integration planning and execution
* Carve-out and separation planning and execution, including standalone cost analysis
* Synergy identification, planning, tracking and execution

Your responsibilities as a Manager will include, but are not limited to:

  

* Support firm leadership with the day-to-day management of multiple projects across various value creation mandates and lead junior team members to successful execution
* Support the development and execution of value creation, integration and separation strategies
* Manage project-level stakeholders across functions to ensure ongoing project alignment, effective and efficient delivery and client satisfaction
* Lead functional and cross-functional delivery teams in developing and executing plans, monitoring progress, and achieving deal objectives and value creation targets
* Provide hands-on support to delivery teams in functional due diligence analysis, integration and carve-out mandates, structural and operational improvements, etc.
* Support leaders in managing project and risk identification, and contribute to quality control for quantitative and qualitative analysis and overall deliverables
* Support business development and pursuit activities to drive sales and revenue
* Support DDV leadership with firm-building activities, i.e. talent development, performance management, etc.
* Coach and develop team members – aligned with PwC’s values – to help them grow and thrive in their roles and to evolve as professionals within the firm
* As part of the transaction process, the DDV team rapidly develops a deep understanding of the target or client business in order to identify and assess key operational issues, synergies, risks, and value-creation opportunities surrounding each transaction.

**What You’ll Bring:**

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:

* A foundation of advisory experience with a desire to build trusted advisor relationships with clients, grounded in competence in value creation and integrations and separations.
* Experience providing hands-on leadership to strategic M&A projects, with knowledge of mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures — including pre-deal functional due diligence, integration planning, separation planning, standalone costing, synergy and cost savings analysis, and post-close transformation.
* Proven ability to deliver the full cycle of project management responsibilities and to manage teams through complex engagements, including managing multiple engagements simultaneously.
* Working knowledge of key functional areas such as HR, IT, Finance, Operations and Sales and Marketing.
* Demonstration of exposure across one or more industry sectors, including Financial Services, Telecom, Consumer Products, Energy, Industrials and Infrastructure.
* Ability to develop and manage strategic client relationships while consistently delivering the highest quality work across multiple concurrent client projects.
* Strong capability in developing both quantitative and qualitative analyses of complex data combined with critical thinking skills to support recommendations and decision-making.
* Experience supporting business development and pursuit activities, both internally with client pursuit teams and externally through client-facing meetings and proposal discussions.
* A drive to embrace AI to bring innovation, efficiency and differentiation to our clients along with a desire to continuously upskill for a digital world, with an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
* A demonstrated commitment to valuing differences, developing and coaching diverse teams, and ensuring that diverse perspectives are heard and integrated.
* The ability and willingness to travel within Canada and internationally, as required.

This position ensures continuity and upholds our standards of excellence following the departure of a valued team member.

The salary range for this position is $112,500 - $162,600. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.

**Why you’ll love PwC**

We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Title: Locating Operations Manager
Description:
**Company / division** Danella Line Services, Inc.

**Location** Delaware, field-based (service area: Delaware and Maryland's Eastern Shore, Cecil and Harford counties)

**Employment type** Full-time, on-site/field

**Reports to** Regional Manager, Delaware

**About the Role**
==================

At Danella, we believe in developing and retaining the best people and providing the best value services to our customers. We take pride in everything we do to maintain the nation's infrastructure by connecting people and resources.

Danella is hiring a Locating Operations Manager for our Locating Division, based in Delaware. Our locators mark underground electric, gas, fiber and telecom facilities for utility and cooperative customers across Delaware and Maryland. This position runs day-to-day locating operations so that every 811 ticket is completed safely, on time and profitably.

The Locating Operations Manager works directly with the Regional Manager, a team of locate supervisors, the field workforce, and our accounting and payroll staff. You will be responsible to manage the daily numbers: tickets completed, production per locator, overtime, timesheets, idle time, ticket deadlines and billing data. This role suits a hands-on leader who is able to hold supervisors accountable and develop teams.

**Responsibilities**
====================

The Locating Operations Manager is responsible for meeting our customers' on-time, quality and safety requirements while controlling labor cost. Strong communication with supervisors, locators, accounting and leadership is essential.

* Lead daily locating operations for 80+ locators and a team of locate supervisors across Delaware and Maryland
* Run a daily operations meeting with supervisors to review the prior day's production, overtime, idle time and open tickets, and assign follow-up
* Set clear production expectations (tickets per locator per day and per hour) and coaching locators who fall short of safety or production
* Monitor ticket boards through the day, rebalance workloads, reassign tickets when locators call out, and route emergency tickets to the closest available locator
* Manage ticket due times and extensions to meet on-time requirements and avoid late-ticket and no-response penalties, including end-of-day board checks on a rotating evening and weekend schedule
