Title: Director of Business Technology
Description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

**TO APPLY**

Qualified candidates are invited to apply directly through this posting.

*Liteline Corporation is an equal opportunity employer that values the unique skills and experiences of every candidate. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and hiring process. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.*

Title: Senior Technical Adoption Manager
Description:

**Job Description:**
--------------------

Why will you enjoy this new opportunity?

Does helping organizations achieve their business goals through the usage of technology inspire you? If it does, we have the perfect job opportunity for you!  
As a VCF Technical Account Manager (TAM) you will enjoy using your technical, communication and collaboration skills to help our customers achieve their full potential through their adoption of VMware by Broadcom technologies.

Upon joining our Customer Success Technical Adoption Management team, you will have the opportunity to bring your authentic self to work and use your skills to make an impact and drive change for our customers, products, and company.  
You will interact daily with your assigned customers and will be able to make a real impact in their success as a business. TAMs find nothing more satisfying than being challenged and being able to turn challenges into positive outcomes. You will need to manage your own schedule and priorities to help our customers achieve their goals. As a TAM, you will have the opportunity to specialize in a VMware solution area by developing & maintaining deep technical knowledge & skills for related VMware by Broadcom products. You will also be able to create a long-term relationship with your assigned customers while developing an understanding of the customer’s technical goals as they align to their business goals and overall impact of VMware’s solutions on business results.  
Success in the Role: What are the performance outcomes over the first 6-12 months you will work toward completing?

During the first year, you will onboard into the TAM role and work with your assigned customers.  

* The first thing that you will achieve is completing a well-organized five-week onboarding plan that will be prepared for you
* You will continue developing & maintaining deep technical knowledge & skills for a given VMware technology area.
* Three months after engaging with your customers, you will be able to articulate their long-term and short-term goals and how they connect to the bigger picture of their business — identifying the gaps that need to be resolved and working on a structured engagement plan with the customer.
* You will establish a long-term relationship with your customers
* You will partner with your customers to accelerate their desired outcomes through best practice guidance that enables rapid deployments and adoption of VMware technologies
* You will educate your customers on emerging technologies and align their technical roadmaps with VMware’s
* If not already certified, you will aim to achieve your VCP (VMware Certified Professional) to help you achieve your goals and objectives.
* Between six to eleven months from your joining date, you will be able to present your achievements using the internal tools and deliverables that we will provide to you.
* You will provide project leadership, coordination, and architectural guidance for the customer’s major VMware initiatives.
* You will serve as an advocate for your customer(s), providing clear and constructive product feedback to VMware product management teams based on customer use-cases and requirements.
* You will be seeking advanced certification and/or knowledge in the solution area you want to specialize in.

The Work: What type of work will you be doing? What assignments, requirements, or skills will you be performing on a regular basis?  
As part of the Customer Success TAM team, you will be working for a long-term period with several assigned and strategic customers. The activities performed are all aligned with a single purpose, to help our customers achieve their desired outcomes while using VMware technology. By helping our customers, we will also help drive the adoption and consumption of the VMware technologies the customer has purchased.

The number of customers will vary depending on which tier of service the customer purchases. You will also be collaborating with the broader VMware account team and specialists as you perform the following:  

* Leverage a TAM playbook, delivery kits, and tools, which you will use to help guide your customer through the following activities:
* Deliver technology roadmaps & assessments that provide next step and outcome-focused plans
* Provide Solution Guidance & best practices review to identify performance optimization opportunities
* Optimize Operations to confirm activities are aligned with stated technology goals & priorities
* Provide Industry insights and benchmarking to realize cost savings and reduce operational risk
* You will use your organizational and planning skills to keep track of your customer's plans, adjusting as needed, and driving them to completion.
* You will help VMware to create ‘customers for life’ by collaborating with our Customer Success, Global Support, Education, Professional Services, Development, and Sales teams- all to make sure that we drive outcome-focused value to our customers.
* You will also contribute back to the internal global TAM community of like-minded experts, sharing the experiences that you gain by working with your customers(s), while also learning from your peers.

Solution Stack Expertise (minimum 5 years and more in two or more of the below technologies):

* VMware Cloud Foundation
* vSphere (vCenter and ESXi)
* NSX-T and Advanced Threat Protection
* vSAN
* Aria Suite of Products (Operations, Operations for Logs, Operations for Networks, Automation)
* Site Recovery Manager
* vCloud Director (low priority)

Certifications:  

* Minimum Vmware Certified Professional in one domain (multiple domains a plus)
* Vmware Certified Advanced Professional (any certification in VCAP level is a plus)
* VCIX
* Industry certifications such as (PMP, CISA, ITIL, Azure, AWS, GCP, CCNA/CCNP is a plus)

Title: Project Manager
Description:
Enable high-performing Agile and hybrid delivery teams to deliver digital and SAP-led automotive initiatives by managing the end-to-end project lifecycle, coaching Scrum practices, removing impediments, and ensuring delivery aligns with the product roadmap, agreed timelines, scope, quality and approved budgets - operating within the PPM&OE framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Manage the project from initiation to closure following the PPM&OE Project Management Plan (PMP) standards — Charter, Planning, Execution, Monitoring and Ways of Working.

* Establish and maintain the project schedule, scope, budget, quality, risks/issues, communications, vendor and resource plans; baseline and track variances with a 'get-to-green' plan when off track.

* Drive project kickoff, stakeholder identification, PMP baseline, business blueprint sign-off, SIT/UAT readiness, cutover, go-live, hypercare and closure (PMO Closure Report).

* Manage chargebacks, monthly cost reconciliation and POD/IO-level financial tracking; ensure timely chargeback initiation and approvals with Finance.

**Agile / Scrum Leadership**

* Coach the team on the Scrum framework, Agile values and principles to improve delivery maturity.

* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies — Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives and Backlog Refinement.

* Remove impediments and shield the team from external distractions to ensure focused delivery.

* Partner with Technical Product Owners (TPOs) and business stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with the product vision and roadmap.

**Stakeholder Management & Governance**

* Act as the primary point of contact between delivery teams, business product owners, vendors and partners.

* Set expectations and align roles of team members and stakeholders early in onboarding; formalize the RACI.

* Take a pro-active approach — communicate 'current week + 1' activities and key meetings; create Teams collaboration spaces; invite only required stakeholders to meetings.

* Run Steering Committees, Program Review Boards, weekly status, and workshops with wider stakeholders; manage escalations to Program Manager / Head of PPM&OE.

* Comply with the PPM&OE Change Management, Document Management, Naming Convention, Quality Gate, Financial Management and Schedule Management processes.

**Business Analysis & Solutioning**

* Support discovery phases — scoping, solutioning, high-level effort estimation, and high-level timeline forecasting (workshops with internal/external teams, vendor discussions, RFI/RFP, SDAF).

* Demonstrate business analytical capability to understand product dynamics, contribute to strategic decisions, and challenge requirements where needed.

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Provide transparent, timely status reports on progress, risks, dependencies, cost vs forecast, and benefit realization.

* Monitor team capacity, highlight risks and flag cost/schedule variances early.

* Promote continuous improvement and contribute to Agile maturity across the Automotive portfolio.

Requirements
  
  

**Must-Have**

* 8+ years of overall IT delivery experience, with 5+ years as a Project Manager / Scrum Master in Agile and hybrid delivery environments.

* Proven track record of delivering digital and/or SAP-led transformation projects, ideally in Automotive (Sales, Aftersales, Parts, B2B/Tradepoint, Omnichannel) or comparable enterprise domains.

* Strong facilitation, coaching and stakeholder management skills — including senior business stakeholders at LOB Director / Head-of level.

* Hands-on experience managing multi-vendor delivery (onsite, nearshore, offshore) and integration points across SAP, digital layers (front-end, microservices, middleware/Boomi) and 3rd-party platforms.

* Working knowledge of capacity planning, delivery forecasting, CAPEX/OPEX cost drivers, chargeback and financial governance.

* Proficiency in JIRA, Microsoft Project / Project Online, Confluence, SharePoint, Teams.

**Nice-to-Have**

* UAE / GCC experience and exposure to conglomerate environments.

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, RISE, EWM, Inventory Management, B2C E-Commerce or B2B Trading platforms.
* Proficiency in Visio and Power BI for reporting
* Experience in Generative AI tools

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or related discipline.

* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe, or equivalent) mandatory.

* PMP or PRINCE2 — preferred.

* Agile coaching certification is an added advantage.

Title: Head of NA Specialty Care, Integrated Evidence and Patient Outcomes
Description:
**Job title***: Head of NA Specialty Care, Integrated Evidence and Patient Outcome*

* **Location:** *Cambridge, MA or Morristown, NJ*

**About the Job**

Sanofi is seeking a visionary and strategic leader to serve as Head of Integrated Evidence & Patient Outcomes for North America Specialty Care Medical. This executive will define and lead the U.S. evidence generation and outcomes strategy across the Specialty Care portfolio, integrating real-world evidence, patient outcomes, population health, organized systems engagement, and advanced analytics to improve healthcare decision making and patient impact. The role serves as the primary North America Medical leader responsible for translating data into actionable evidence, shaping engagement with health systems and payers, and advancing Sanofi's transformation toward a data-driven, AI-enabled medical organization.

This role also partners closely with Sanofi’s Global Integrated Evidence Generation and Global RWE organizations to ensure global evidence strategies and study designs reflect the U.S. patient population and healthcare landscape, and leads the evolution of the North America customer engagement model across organized health systems, payers, and key accounts. Reporting to North America Medical Head, Specialty Care, this is a highly visible role at the center of North America Medical's broader shift toward data-driven, AI-enabled evidence generation and engagement, and this role will be part of the North America Medical Specialty Care leadership team.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

**About Sanofi**

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system — and innovative pipeline — enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Own the North America integrated evidence strategy for the Specialty Care portfolio, setting direction across the Integrated Evidence, Real World Evidence, Population Health, and Data Foundation teams to meet the needs of U.S. patients, providers, payers, and health systems.
* Set priorities on evidence gaps specific to the U.S. market at a portfolio level, guiding investment decisions with cross-functional partners, including R&D, Commercial, and Global Medical.
* Ensure evidence generation activities across the pillar support U.S. regulatory, access, and clinical practice needs.
* Ensure generation of evidence supporting clinical, economic, and patient-centered outcomes that inform healthcare decision-making, value assessment, access, and quality improvement.
* Provide strategic oversight of organized systems engagement, ensuring evidence generation priorities are informed by the needs of integrated delivery networks, accountable care organizations, health systems, and payer stakeholders.
* Champion the adoption of advanced analytics, AI-enabled insights, and scalable data infrastructure to enhance understanding of patient journeys, treatment patterns, and health outcomes.
* Serve as a senior scientific leader representing Sanofi in collaborations with academic institutions, health systems, research networks, policy organizations, and other external stakeholders shaping evidence generation and patient outcomes.
* Serve as the senior North America Medical sponsor of the partnership with Sanofi's Global RWE organization, ensuring global evidence generation strategies and study designs appropriately represent U.S. patient populations (with the US Integrated Evidence Generation Lead serving as day-to-day counterpart).
* Advocate at a senior level for U.S.-specific considerations — including real-world data sources, diverse patient populations, and healthcare delivery patterns — in global RWE planning and prioritization.
* Ensure findings from global RWE initiatives are made actionable for U.S. stakeholders through the Integrated Evidence and Real-World Evidence teams.
* Set direction for the team's real-world evidence program, ensuring studies inform clinical and payer decisions in partnership with Commercial, Clinical Development, Market Access, and HEVA.
* Oversee population health, quality, and research partnership priorities with system-level stakeholders, aligning the team's care gap initiatives and quality measure strategy across therapeutic areas.
* Champion the use of data integration, EHR enhancements, and evidence-based analytics to help health systems strengthen clinical workflows and decision-making.
* Set the vision and priorities for the pillar's data and informatics capabilities — including AI/ML, health information technology (HIT), and real-world and real-time data — that enable robust generation, analysis, and application of patient-level evidence in the U.S.
* Ensure field and data signals are translated into actionable insights, including medical impact and care gaps, through the Data Foundation team's center of excellence for medical analytics.
* Ensure the team's approach to scientific exchange and evidence-based value demonstration stays aligned with the pillar's broader evidence and data strategy.
* Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing team across the pillar's functional areas: payer and health system engagement, integrated evidence, real world evidence, population health, and data and analytics.
* Foster a culture of scientific excellence, cross-functional collaboration (including with Global RWE), and patient-centricity.
* Help steer the pillar's strategy and ways of working in line with North America Medical's broader transformation toward data-driven, AI-enabled evidence generation and engagement.
* Accountable for prioritization and stewardship of U.S. evidence-generation investments across the Specialty Care portfolio in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders

Basic Qualifications

* Advanced degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. MD, PhD, PharmD).
* Minimum of 15 years’ experience in Medical Affairs, including minimum of 7 years’ experience leading a medical function focused on evidence generation, RWE, R&D, or data analytics.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience leading high performing teams with proven track record of effectively developing talent.
* Demonstrated leadership of large-scale evidence generation programs.
* Deep understanding of U.S. healthcare delivery, payer, and organized systems landscape.
* Experience leveraging RWD/RWE in support of medical, regulatory, access, or quality improvement objectives.
* Proven ability to influence enterprise strategy through data and evidence.
* Must possess ethical standards of the highest level and have the knowledge and ability to comply with all relevant ethical, regulatory, and legal standards.
* Strong track record in developing and executing medical strategies in the U.S.
* Proven track record of building and maintaining a KOL network in U.S.

* Extensive experience and an excellent track record in dealing with safety issues is required.
* Must have experience of working within a complex and international company and must be able to work in a matrix environment.
* Must be fluent in English and possess superb written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Advanced training certification in Comprehensive Research Evidence Synthesis Training (CREST), RWE/RWD, or other relevant coursework.
* Has an entrepreneurial vision with strong execution of that vision.
* Outstanding interpersonal communication, negotiation and networking skills.
* Has critical thinking and problem-solving mindset.
* Excellent planning, project management, budget management, and portfolio prioritization skills.

Title: Panel Builder Program Leader META
Description:
**Job Description**
Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
  
  
**About Eaton**
Eaton is a power management company where we provide energy-efficient solutions that help our customers effectively manage electrical, hydraulic and mechanical power more efficiently, safely and sustainably. Eaton is dedicated to improving the quality of life and the environment through the use of power management technology and services. Eaton has approximately 96,000 employees and sells products to customers in more than 175 countries.
  
  
The
**Panel Builder Program Manager, META**
is responsible for developing, governing and scaling Eaton’s panel builder partner program across the Middle East, Türkiye and Africa. The role creates a consistent regional framework that enables Eaton to recruit, engage, develop and grow panel builder partners while allowing effective adaptation to local market needs.
  
  
Reporting to Commercial Excellence & Marketing META, the role works through country sales, channel marketing, product and segment teams to strengthen partner capability, increase specification and preference for Eaton solutions, generate sustainable project pipeline and improve Eaton’s share of wallet. The role provides functional leadership to the regional panel builder community and serves as the central marketing and program contact for strategic panel builder partners.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the META panel builder program strategy, framework, value proposition, governance and annual operating plan, aligned with regional commercial priorities and Eaton’s brand standards.
* Define partner segmentation, qualification criteria and tiering based on capability, market potential, strategic fit, performance and commitment to Eaton.
* Design the end-to-end partner lifecycle covering recruitment, onboarding, certification, enablement, activation, development, retention and performance management.
* Build differentiated benefits and requirements for each program tier, including training, technical support, demand generation, digital tools, recognition and joint business planning.
* Lead functional alignment of country sales and marketing teams responsible for local program deployment; provide playbooks, tools, training and performance guidance.
* Develop joint business and marketing plans with priority panel builders, including agreed growth objectives, target segments, opportunity pipelines, campaigns and investment plans.
* Coordinate technical and commercial enablement with Product, Segment, Sales and Engineering teams, including solution training, design support, application guidance and new-product introductions.
* Create scalable to-partner and through-partner communications, localized content, co-branded campaigns and events that increase engagement and generate demand.
* Drive adoption of partner portals, product configurators, digital design tools, partner locators, customer relationship management and other relevant digital platforms.
* Establish clear program measures and dashboards covering partner recruitment, certification, engagement, pipeline, conversion, revenue, share of wallet, digital adoption and satisfaction.
* Govern program investments and marketing development funds, ensuring transparent allocation, compliant execution and measurable return on investment.
* Capture partner and customer feedback through structured voice-of-customer activities, advisory forums and satisfaction surveys; translate insights into program improvements.
* Coordinate relationships with strategic regional panel builders and relevant industry associations while supporting country teams in developing local partner communities.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, engineering or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in B2B channel, partner-program, commercial or marketing roles within the electrical industry. Demonstrated experience working across multiple META markets and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority is required.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of panel building, low-voltage electrical distribution, partner-program design and channel business models.
* Proficiency in partner segmentation, joint business planning, demand generation, pipeline management, marketing investment governance, performance analytics and digital partner platforms.
* Working knowledge of applicable data-privacy, competition and compliance requirements.
* Advanced stakeholder management, communication, presentation, facilitation and influencing skills.
* Strong strategic and analytical thinking, customer focus, cultural awareness, project management, accountability and decision-making.
* Able to lead through influence, manage competing priorities and convert partner insight into scalable regional actions.

**Living and Working in Dubai**
Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
  
  
At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.

Title: Operations Scaling Manager
Description:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
Own the operational blueprint for scaling markets through distinct growth phases — from launch (0–5K orders/day) through rapid growth (5K–20K) to mature operations (20K+). This is a hands-on role: redesigning shift structures as volume doubles, deciding when to transition fleet models, building playbooks that turn a 10-person team into a 50-person team without losing service quality. Also serves as the primary Operations liaison to Product and Tech, ensuring the platform evolves to support each scaling phase.
  
  
**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**

* Own the end-to-end operational scaling playbook for each growth phase: launch (0–5K orders/day), growth (5K–20K), and maturity (20K+) — defining what changes at each transition in team structure, processes, tooling, fleet model, and vendor operations.
* Lead the 0→5K phase: establish baseline SOPs, set up live ops monitoring, define zone structures, build vendor operations cadence, align on-ground and remote teams before launch.
* Lead the 5K→20K transition: identify and resolve bottlenecks that break at scale — dispatch assignment times, CS capacity, vendor prep time spikes, zone boundaries, shift roster restructuring.
* Plan the 20K+ operating model: org structure, automation requirements, fleet model evolution, advanced zone optimization, predictive capacity planning.
* Define clear scaling triggers — the specific metric thresholds that signal when a market needs to transition to the next phase.
* Build capacity planning models that translate order volume forecasts into headcount, fleet size, and vendor capacity requirements with lead times factored in.
* Identify when manual processes become unsustainable and scope automation requirements — auto-dispatch rules, automated vendor scoring, self-serve CS tools — then work with Product/Tech to build them.
* Run post-scaling retrospectives after each phase transition: what broke, what held, what we should have done earlier. Feed lessons into the playbook for the next market.
* Conduct operational stress tests: simulate peak scenarios, holiday surges, and failure modes to identify scaling weaknesses before they hit production.
* Act as primary Operations liaison for Product and Tech — translate real scaling pain points into product requirements and feature requests.
* Participate in product roadmap planning, advocating for features that enable scaling: auto-dispatch improvements, dynamic zone management, automated vendor onboarding, real-time capacity dashboards.
* Monitor operational impact of product releases.

**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* 5–7 years in operations management within delivery, logistics, e-commerce, or marketplace businesses — with direct experience scaling operations through significant volume growth.
* Proven track record of building or scaling operational teams and processes from early stage to high volume (not just optimizing mature operations).
* Deep understanding of delivery operations mechanics: dispatch logic, fleet management, zone design, vendor operations, live ops, CS operations.
* Experience with fleet model transitions (3PL → hybrid → own fleet) and the operational implications of each.
* Strong analytical skills — able to build capacity models, staffing calculators, and cost projections. Advanced Excel/Sheets required.
* Experience working at the intersection of Operations and Product, translating operational needs into product requirements.
* Familiarity with product management tools (Jira, Asana, ClickUp, or similar) and agile methodologies.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management — this role works with everyone from dispatchers to C-suite.

Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to create a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by **engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week**. Our head office is purposely designed with collaboration in mind, providing space where teams can come together to strategize, brainstorm and connect on key projects.

**About the Role**

Enterprise Data Enablement (EDE) is AstraZeneca’s enterprise capability for enabling trusted, connected and reusable data across the organisation. Working with Business Technology Group (BTG) IT teams, SET Area Data Offices (SEDEs) and data delivery teams, EDE brings together data strategy, architecture, governance, platforms and delivery to support Data Mesh-aligned data products, analytical solutions and AI-ready data. The Enterprise AI (EAI) vision depends on this foundation: semantic modelling provides the governed meaning and context that let AI consistently understand and connect data across Commercial and the wider enterprise.

Our global Enterprise Information Architecture (EIA) Practice works within EDE, specializing in Enterprise Information Architecture, Information Architecture, Data Modelling and Data Analysis. We design the key aspects of the data world for AstraZeneca across our global customer businesses, offering critical services focused upon the ingestion, extraction, processing, transformation, transport, storage and representation of knowledge, analysis and modelling of our essential data and facts. We use leading thinking, processes, and methods to achieve enduring outcomes for projects and business-as-usual working, and lead on enterprise-level, cross organizational information architecture, for example around the definition and delivery of Data Products and alignment with Data Mesh, Data Platforms, FAIR and TRUST Data thinking across our businesses.

The EIA practice is seeking an Information Architect aligned to Commercial IT. Working with Senior Information Architects and the Head/Lead of Information Architecture Commercial, the role will contribute to the definition and governance of information architectures, ontologies, semantic models and metadata standards across Commercial IT and one or more projects/programmes. A key focus is the Commercial ontology portfolio in Metaphactory: the Commercial Conceptual Domain Ontology for Market and Sell and the application ontologies underpinning data products for programmes such as Customer 2030, Future CRM, One Data Foundation and Commercial AI. The EIA Commercial team partners across all the Commercial global functions including (not exhaustive) Marketing, Medical, Commercial Excellence, Patient and Market Access across the markets. The role will also support the definition of enterprise Data Strategies which may include information and data, regulatory or technical governances in a Data Mesh architecture, data innovation, enterprise architectures, governance policies, standards and procedures.**This is a hybrid role located in Wilmington, DE. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of the office or be willing to relocate for this opportunity.**

* Responsible for delivering coherent tactical, and contributing to strategic, architectural thinking across information and data architectures, MRDM, data strategies, ontology and semantic modelling, and information and data governances.

* Responsible for working within the Enterprise Data Architecture Framework, applying and extending leading practices, models (conceptual, logical, physical, semantic), standards, frameworks, and the overall Blueprint for a project.

* Build and maintain Commercial ontologies, taxonomies and controlled vocabularies in line with the EIA Ontology Framework and Playbook, including supporting the migration of legacy ER/Studio models into governed Metaphactory ontologies.

* Support the Head/Lead of Information Architecture Commercial and Senior Information Architects in developing and applying strategy and best practice for Information Architecture, in partnership with the AstraZeneca business functions, solution developments and functional projects.

* Support architecture and technology evangelization, architecture roadmap, and alignment within assigned Commercial projects.

* Contribute to architecture, leading practice, and technology education, including ontology and semantic literacy.

* Contribute to Architectural Governance, including preparing Architectural Decisions and progressing work to appropriate governance and assurance forums (e.g. EIAAB), boards and councils.

**Commercial Information Architecture aligned Accountabilities:**

* Deliver Information Architecture (IA), conceptual, logical and semantic models, for operational, master and data products including data models, information flows, master/reference data, ontology and metadata designs to meet Business Capability requirements.

* Work with business and IT stakeholders to evolve IA and semantic designs to support business strategy.

* Own the IA designs and application ontologies for assigned data products or Business capability areas, reusing the Commercial Conceptual Domain Ontology.

* Provide IA for projects within Commercial IT, escalating enterprise-level design decisions to Senior Information Architects.

* Work with the Commercial Data Office to ensure data governance processes are enabled in IA designs and provide assurance evidence through standardised metrics: e.g., master data consumption, data classification metadata application to support access processes, ontology adoption.

* Select and apply the correct architecture and patterns to fulfill traditional reporting (management information, business intelligence) and analytics, data science, digital, operational and AI business use cases, with attention to AI-readiness.

This includes:

* Providing tactical data architecture planning, design expertise and execution application on development projects, from technical designs and technology standards to Models and IA considerations.
* Contributing coherent architectural thinking in support of data and other strategies, enterprise data and information architectures, and knowledge-graph enabled use cases.

* Gains approval for the various IA artifacts ensuring enforcement of standard enterprise data element names, abbreviations, characteristics, and domains during the lifecycle of a project.

* Experience in the use of conceptual, logical and semantic data modelling technologies, including ontology or taxonomy design.

* Understanding of ontologies, semantic layers and knowledge graphs, and how they enable interoperable, AI-ready data.

* Understanding the appropriate data structure and technology based on business use case and completely familiar with data lifecycles.

Title: Business Operations Manager
Description:
**Business Operations Manager**

*• Business Development • Dubai, UAE • Justlife*

Right now, thousands of people in the UAE book a cleaner through Justlife and expect them to show up on time, do excellent work, and leave their home better than they found it. That promise only holds if the cleaners are there, trained, motivated, and routed efficiently — which means someone has to own the daily operating reality of that supply chain: keeping cleaners deployed, partners accountable, costs disciplined, and quality high.

This is an operations role, not a strategy role. You'll run the DTC home cleaning business end-to-end — 300+ cleaners across multiple partner companies, a small on-ground team of account executives and roster agents, and **measurable improvement in on-time performance, completion rates, and contribution margin within your first six months**. Every day you'll make decisions that move the numbers: which partner hires next, how to incentivise productivity, where fuel and routing waste money, whether we're hitting our supply plan. This is what it means to own a real business line.

**You'll love this role if you...**

* You think in unit economics and get frustrated when a cost lever stays hidden in a spreadsheet instead of being fixed
* You've run a large field or blue-collar workforce (directly or through partners) and know exactly how to hold external teams accountable without being their boss
* You're energised by problems you can see and touch — you'd rather spend an hour in a van or at a partner accommodation than sit in a meeting
* You build teams that work without you, and you actively coach people into bigger roles
* You obsess over data quality because you know bad reports kill decisions, and you'll learn SQL or Power BI yourself rather than wait for someone to build your dashboard

**What you'll own**

* **Drive sustained improvement in on-time %, completion rate %, promise-kept %, and absent rate %** by building daily operating discipline — reviewing metrics with the team each morning, identifying blockers, and acting on them before they compound into service failures.
* Lead and develop the on-ground operations team (2 account executives and 4 remote roster agents): set clear priorities, review performance daily, coach individuals toward higher capability, and manage accountability.
* Own supply planning and growth: forecast cleaner headcount needed against demand by city and partner, manage onboarding pace and allocation across partner companies, and reduce time-to-deployment so new hires contribute faster.
* Manage partner companies as senior counterparts: run monthly business reviews, hold them to service-level agreements and commercial terms, reconcile statements of account with finance monthly, and escalate issues before they become crises.
* Design and drive cost and process projects that improve contribution margin — incentive structure redesigns, fuel and fleet controls, van routing optimisation, cleaner orientation and training — taking each from idea to measurable result.
* Build and maintain reporting that surfaces what's driving performance: which partners are slipping, where attrition is highest, which cost levers moved margin, what's blocking supply. Act on what it shows.
* Spend meaningful time in the field — in vans, accommodations, and partner sites — so you understand problems first-hand and your team sees you do the same.

**What tells us you're the one**

* You've **measurably improved operational metrics across a large field workforce** — *tell us a specific program you ran (incentive redesign, routing optimisation, vendor onboarding, training rollout, etc.) and the metric that moved as a result: completion rate up X%, on-time performance improved Y%, attrition fell Z%, or margin lifted by N%*.
* You can spot cause and effect: when a metric moves, you know whether it's partner execution, process design, incentive misalignment, or something else — and you know how to test your hypothesis before rolling out a fix.
* You've managed blue-collar, field-based, or logistics workforces (home services, facilities management, staffing, last-mile delivery, quick commerce) — or run marketplace operations where supply quality depends on external partners. Results matter far more than years, but 5–7 years of this kind of work is the sweet spot.
* You're fluent in data: you can build operating reports independently, interrogate a spreadsheet without help, and use SQL, Power BI, or AI tools to automate manual reporting so you have time to think.
* You speak fluent English, written and spoken. Bonus: you speak languages common to the workforce in the UAE (Tagalog, Urdu, Arabic), or you have prior experience operating in the UAE market in home services, logistics, or staffing.

**Why Justlife**

* **Scale and impact:** You'll run a real, revenue-generating business line serving thousands of customers across the UAE, managing hundreds of cleaners and multiple partner companies, with direct line of sight from your decisions to customer satisfaction and margin.
* **Clear growth path:** this role is a launchpad into broader category leadership, multi-city operations, or general management as we scale across the GCC.
* **Close partnership with leadership:** you'll work alongside the Business Development lead and the founding team, with real influence on strategy and resource decisions.
* **A fair, performance-driven culture:** you'll be measured on the metrics you own, recognised through our JustHeroes program, and rewarded for results — not politics.
* **Startup benefits:** a birthday day off (JustHoliday), free Justlife service credits, referral bonuses, and regular team experiences.

***Join the tribe and let's become #everydaybetter, together.***

HungerStation is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. **Purpose**
**Job Description**
To lead the design and execution of strategic initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and drive continuous improvement across the business. This senior leadership role is responsible for developing scalable processes, optimizing performance, and aligning operational strategy with business objectives. The ideal candidate will have a strong focus on strategy development, implementation, and cross-functional collaboration to support the growth and long-term success of the Operations division
  
  
**Key Accountability Areas**

* Develop and execute operational strategies that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and support scalability.
* Align operational goals with the company’s overall business strategy and ensure cross-functional teams are working toward shared objectives.
* Lead strategic initiatives to optimize core processes across logistics, fleet management, marketing, Fintech, product Ops and customer service.
* Drive operational innovation through automation, technology adoption, and process improvements.
* Ensure processes are scalable and adaptable to support business expansion.
* Establish and monitor KPIs to track and measure operational performance across key areas.
* Standardize processes and reporting systems to ensure consistency and transparency across the operations department.
* Conduct regular reviews and audits to assess adherence to best practices and identify areas for improvement.
* Lead cross-functional projects that improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Implement change management practices to ensure successful adoption of new processes, systems, or technologies.
* Develop and implement robust fraud prevention strategies.
* Analyze transaction data to identify patterns and anomalies.
* Collaborate with technology teams to enhance fraud detection algorithms.
* Train and educate operational staff on fraud prevention best practices.
* Continuously monitor and adapt fraud prevention measures.
* Analyze cancellation patterns to identify common reasons
* Implement measures to reduce cancellations
* Minimize the impact of cancellations on resources
* Investigate failed deliveries (e.g., incorrect addresses, customer unavailability).
* Enhance address validation during order placement.
* Implement real-time tracking and communication features for customers and drivers.
* Leverage data analytics to identify wastage trends.
* Use predictive models to anticipate potential wastage scenarios.
* Implement self-service options through our app or website. Automated chatbots can handle routine queries, reducing the need for human agents.

* Outsourcing Consideration: Evaluate outsourcing options for non-core functions (e.g., after-hours support) to reduce in-house costs.
* Root Cause Analysis: Investigate the reasons behind customer complaints (e.g., late deliveries, incorrect orders). Address these issues at the source to prevent recurrence.
* Proactive Communication: Keep customers informed about order status, delays, and any issues. Transparency reduces the need for compensation.
* Tiered Compensation: Define clear guidelines for compensating customers (e.g., partial refunds, vouchers). Tailor compensation based on the severity of the issue.
* Feedback Loop: Collect feedback from customers and learn from their experiences. Use this insight to improve processes and minimize compensation situations.

At Ontario Health, we are committed to developing a strong organizational culture that connects and inspires all team members across the province. How we work together is reflected through our five values: integrity, inspiration, tenacity, humility and care.

**What Ontario Health offers:**

**At Ontario Health, your growth and well-being aren’t just supported—they’re celebrated every step of the way. Here, you have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while shaping a fulfilling and sustainable career. Based on your role, you may receive:**

* **Comprehensive health coverage from day one**, with fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits to support you and your family’s health
* **Flexible health care or wellness spending accounts**, plus an inclusive program to support your overall well-being
* **A premium defined benefit pension plan**, ensuring long-term financial security
* **Competitive vacation entitlement** that encourages time to rest and recharge
* **Three personal days and two float days annually**, providing added flexibility to support work-life balance, in addition to vacation days

**Want to make a difference in your career? Consider this opportunity.**

Reporting to the Director, Patient Access and Navigation Services, the Manager leads the business side of Ontario’s provincial Primary Care Medical Record (PCMR) Program, including governance, planning, finances, procurement, vendor performance and benefits realization, so clinicians, care teams and patients get the most from the PCMR solution.

You will turn direction from Ontario Health, the Ministry of Health and governance bodies into clear plans and measurable outcomes, partnering with clinical, digital, privacy, legal, finance and regional teams. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role for a sound-judgement leader who builds alignment and delivers value for money.

**Here is what you will be doing:**

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach and develop a multidisciplinary team in a matrixed environment, setting clear outcomes and fostering an inclusive, accountable culture.

**Business Program Leadership and Governance**

* Lead PCMR governance, integrated business plans and escalation pathways, coordinate executive and steering committees, and give leadership a consolidated view of scope, finances, risks and readiness.

**Business Planning, Performance and Benefits Realization**

* Lead annual and multi-year planning and define KPIs and benefits tied to service quality, clinician experience and reduced administrative burden, reporting to senior leadership, the Board and the Ministry.

**Financial Management and Funding Oversight**

* Manage program budgets and vendor expenditures, and provide financial analysis that guides investments, negotiations and value for money.

**Procurement, Contract and Vendor Management**

* Lead procurement, contract administration and vendor performance oversight across PCMR and Customer Care vendors, escalating material risks.

**Stakeholder and Partner Management**

* Build trusted relationships with the Ministry of Health, OntarioMD, Ontario Health Teams, Primary Care Networks, clinical leaders and vendors, and build consensus among partners with differing mandates.

**Risk, Compliance and Operational Readiness**

* Identify and mitigate business, financial, privacy and security risks, and ensure business readiness for go-live with auditable program records.

**Here is what you will need to be successful:**

**Education and Experience**

  

* A master’s degree in business administration, Commerce, Health Administration, Public Administration, Project Management, Finance or a related field, or recognized equivalent experience, is preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive leadership experience managing large-scale business, operational, procurement, financial, contract management or transformation initiatives in healthcare, government or another complex, regulated environment.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing complex programs with executive governance, multiple delivery partners, significant vendor relationships and cross-functional dependencies.
* Experience managing operating and project budgets, business planning, financial reporting, procurement processes and contract performance.
* Experience supporting digital health, clinical transformation or large-scale technology-enabled change is strongly preferred.
* PMP, PgMP, MBA, CPA, Lean or an equivalent professional designation is considered an asset.

**Knowledge and Skills**

  

* Strong knowledge of program governance, business management, portfolio and project delivery practices, benefits realization and transition to operations.
* Advanced financial management, budgeting, forecasting, business case and performance reporting skills.
* Strong procurement, contract administration, vendor management and negotiation capabilities.
* Excellent executive communication, briefing, presentation, facilitation and stakeholder relationship management skills.
* Strong strategic thinking, analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, including the ability to identify, prioritize and escalate risks and issues.
* Ability to translate complex clinical, operational, digital and policy considerations into clear business implications, options and recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build alignment, clarify accountabilities and drive results through others in a matrixed, multi-partner environment.
* Understanding of Ontario health system governance, primary care delivery and public-sector accountability frameworks is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of privacy, security, accessibility, information governance and regulatory considerations relevant to digital health programs is an asset.

Title: Director of Channel Partnerships
Description:
**Director of Channel Partnerships**

Referral & Revenue-Share Partnerships | Kleer Circle (kleercircle.com)

**The Opportunity**

Kleer Circle is hiring a Director of Channel Partnerships to build and scale a revenue-generating network of referral and audience partners serving high-income professionals and business owners. You will personally source, negotiate, close, and activate revenue-share and referral partnerships with wealth managers, CPA firms, financial publishers, podcasts, cost segregation companies, and other aligned organizations.

Our target customers are high-earning W-2 professionals and business owners who earn several hundred thousand dollars annually and pay $50,000 or more in annual taxes. We are looking for someone who can identify the organizations and trusted advisors already serving these customers - and turn those relationships into productive, revenue-generating partnerships.

You will own the full partnership lifecycle: sourcing, outreach, negotiation, deal structure, closing, activation, and expansion.

This is a hands-on, new-partner acquisition role - not primarily an account-management position. You must have personally sourced and closed partnerships that produced measurable revenue, not simply managed relationships after agreements were signed.

We need someone who has successfully built this type of channel before - not someone who wants to learn partnership sales on the job.

**What You Will Own**

**Source and close strategic partners**

- Identify and prioritize partners whose clients or audiences closely match Kleer Circle's ideal customer profile.

- Build a repeatable outbound motion targeting decision-makers at advisory firms, financial services businesses, publishers, podcasts, and other relevant organizations.

- Run the entire sales process, from first outreach through signed agreement and launch.

- Build relationships with owners, executives, advisors, and audience operators who can become meaningful distribution partners.

**Structure commercially sound deals**

- Develop and negotiate revenue-share, referral, affiliate, co-marketing, and other partnership arrangements appropriate to each relationship.

- Model partnership economics, including acquisition costs, revenue potential, partner payouts, and contribution margin.

- Establish clear expectations for promotion, lead qualification, attribution, reporting, payment terms, and accountability.

- Coordinate with leadership and legal or compliance advisors to ensure proposed arrangements are appropriate before launch.

**Turn signed agreements into revenue**

- Build activation plans with each partner, including introductions, email campaigns, webinars, podcast integrations, and other relevant initiatives.

- Work with internal teams to create partner messaging, sales materials, and effective prospect handoffs.

- Track the funnel from partner activity through qualified leads, closed customers, and collected revenue.

- Expand productive relationships, fix underperforming programs, and exit partnerships that do not justify the investment.

**Build the partnership function**

- Establish the CRM discipline, pipeline reporting, forecasting, and operating cadence for the channel.

- Create repeatable partner recruitment, onboarding, and management playbooks.

- Bring market feedback to leadership to improve positioning, offers, and conversion.

- Help define when and how to add resources as the channel demonstrates repeatable results.

**Who You Are**

You have a demonstrated record of personally sourcing, structuring, closing, and growing revenue-generating channel partnerships.

- Proven success negotiating revenue-share, referral, affiliate, or comparable performance-based commercial agreements.

- Experience reaching affluent consumers, high-income professionals, business owners, or closely related customer segments through trusted intermediaries.

- Relevant relationships (or ability to create these relationships) across wealth management, accounting, financial media, investing communities, real estate services, or adjacent markets.

- Demonstrated success in advisor partnerships (such as CPAs and wealth managers) or audience partnerships (such as newsletters, podcasts, and publishers), with credible evidence you can execute across both.

- Strong financial judgment: you can distinguish an attractive partnership announcement from an economically attractive distribution channel.

- The ability to sell to sophisticated counterparties and navigate multiple stakeholders without losing momentum.

- An operator's discipline around follow-through, attribution, forecasting, and measurable results.

- The willingness to do the work yourself - from prospect research and outbound outreach to contract negotiation and partner activation.

Experience in tax-related services, wealth management, alternative investments, financial publishing, or other trust-intensive businesses is especially relevant.

**What Success Looks Like**

You will be measured on business outcomes - not networking activity or the number of agreements signed.

- Partner-sourced collected revenue and contribution margin.

- Qualified pipeline generated through partners.

- Number of active, productive partnerships.

- Time from signed agreement to first qualified opportunity and first revenue.

- Partner-level acquisition economics and conversion rates.

- Revenue growth and durability across the partner portfolio.

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume and a brief summary of two or three partnerships you personally sourced and closed. For each, include:

- The partner type and target customer.

- Your specific role in sourcing, negotiating, and activating the relationship.

- The commercial structure, described at a level that respects confidentiality.

- The revenue or other measurable business results generated.

- How long the partnership took to become productive.

We care most about what you have built, what it produced, and whether you can do it again.

Pay: $250,000.00 - $350,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

Title: Director
Description:
The Americas GSI team builds and runs Rubrik's go-to-market with the world's largest system integrators, including Accenture, Deloitte, Cognizant, HCLTech, Infosys, Kyndryl, TCS, Wipro, LTIMindtree, and others.

We make Rubrik part of how GSIs deliver cyber resilience to enterprise customers: sourcing pipeline, co-selling with Rubrik's field, and building joint offerings and managed services around Rubrik.

Our structure has three parts: Global Account Managers (GAMs) who own executive relationships with each GSI, specialty sellers who drive workload-specific motions such as Microsoft 365 and Identity Resilience, and BDMs who convert partner relationships into pipeline, deals, and enabled partner teams.

We work daily with Rubrik AEs, SEs, Regional Directors, Marketing, Partner Programs, Product, and the Microsoft and cloud alliance teams, and we are part of a global GSI organization.

**What This Role Will Be Doing****:**

* Build and lead the BDM organization for the Americas, and own the Sell-Through and Sell-With motions across all strategic GSIs.
* Sell-Through: drive GSI-led and services-led deals where the partner is the primary route to the customer, including partner-sourced new-logo (PSNL) and partner-sourced expansion (PSX) opportunities, deal registration, and managed service offerings.
* Sell-With: orchestrate co-sell between GSI account teams and Rubrik's AEs, SEs, and Regional Directors on named accounts, with clear account ownership, joint plans, and minimal channel conflict.
* Set a common operating model for all BDMs: target account planning, pipeline generation, weekly deal reviews, forecast, and Salesforce data quality.
* Work with the GAMs, who report to the RVP, so every GSI has one coordinated plan covering executive relationships, pipeline, enablement, and joint offerings.
* Align BDMs with the specialty sellers on joint solution plays such as Microsoft 365 and Identity Resilience, so partner motions are consistent and not duplicated.
* Own pipeline and bookings targets for the BDM organization, and report progress, risks, and wins to the RVP, global GSI leadership, and executive stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**:
  
  
*Leadership and Team Building*

* Hire, coach, and develop BDMs; set clear goals, territories or partner assignments, and performance expectations.
* Create a culture of accountability, urgency, and collaboration with AEs, SEs, GAMs, and specialty sellers.
* Build repeatable playbooks for pipeline generation, partner engagement, deal support, and win capture.

*Pipeline and Revenue*

* Own a quarterly pipeline and bookings plan across all GSIs, with a clear split between sell-through and sell-with.
* Drive account mapping and target list creation with each GSI and Rubrik's field, prioritized by customer fit, partner presence, and deal potential.
* Run the weekly cadence: pipeline reviews, deal inspections, commit and forecast, and escalation of blockers.
* Hold the team to disciplined Salesforce hygiene, including partner attribution, account categorization, and deal registration.

*Partner Programs and Enablement*

* Ensure each GSI has a joint business plan, named target accounts, executive sponsors, and quarterly milestones.
* Lead sales and technical enablement for GSI sellers, architects, and delivery teams on Rubrik's Cloud Resilience, Identity Resilience, and Microsoft 365 value.
* Partner with Product, Product Marketing, and Partner Programs on joint offerings, pricing and packaging guidance, and repeatable assets.

*Field Alignment and Visibility*

* Establish rules of engagement with Rubrik Sales Leadership and Regional Directors on account ownership, deal registration, and partner involvement.
* Plan joint campaigns, workshops, and executive briefings with Marketing and each GSI.
* Publish win stories and references; provide a weekly and quarterly view of partner performance to leadership.

**Why This Role, and Why Rubrik, Right Now**:

* Build a function, not maintain one. You will define how Rubrik runs sell-through and sell-with across every strategic GSI in the Americas, with real latitude to set the operating model and build the team.
* A category with urgency behind it. Ransomware, identity attacks, cloud complexity, and AI adoption have made cyber resilience a board-level priority, and GSIs are leading much of that work.
* One platform, several partner plays. Rubrik's story spans data protection, cyber recovery, Cloud Resilience, Identity Resilience, and Microsoft 365, so your BDMs can bring GSIs a bigger and more strategic conversation than a single-product vendor can.
* GSIs are a strategic priority, not a side channel. GSI leadership reports into the Chief Solutions Officer organization, with dedicated GAMs, specialty sellers, and BDMs working as one team on the same accounts.
* Leadership visibility. You report to the Americas GSI RVP in a global GSI organization, and early wins will be seen by senior leaders and shape how Rubrik works with GSIs worldwide.
* Momentum and scale. Rubrik is a publicly traded company with a growing enterprise footprint, giving you resources, credibility with partners, and room to grow.

**Required Qualifications****:**

* 12+ years in enterprise software, cybersecurity, or data protection, including 5+ years leading partner, alliance, or business development teams.
* Proven record of building and scaling teams that generate pipeline and close six- and seven-figure deals through GSIs or large services partners.
* Deep understanding of how GSIs operate: account teams, practices, delivery, and services-led deal structures, and how to drive both sell-through and co-sell.
* Experience working across direct sales and partner organizations, including territory and account ownership and channel conflict management.
* Strong forecasting, operating rhythm, and Salesforce discipline; ability to run a metrics-driven team.
* Excellent executive presence, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work across time zones with partner teams in the US and India; travel of approximately 30-40%.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Established relationships with major GSIs, such as Accenture, Deloitte, HCLTech, Cognizant, Infosys, Wipro, Kyndryl, TCS, and LTIMindtree.
* Background in data protection, cyber resilience, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with Microsoft, AWS, or Google Cloud co-sell and marketplace motions.
* Familiarity with MEDDPICC and partner-led deal registration processes.
